<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>لوحة المتابعة</title>
<meta name="description" content="لوحة تنفيذية لمتابعة التدريبات و الاختبارات المصنعية في السعودية للطاقة: التكاليف، المرشحون، التوزيع الجغرافي والتصنيفي لكافة الإدارات.">
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0D5FC4">
<link rel="icon" type="image/png" href="data:image/png;base64,">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Sans+Arabic:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&family=Readex+Pro:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/Chart.js/4.4.1/chart.umd.min.js"></script>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#F3F8FC;
    --surface:#FFFFFF;
    --surface-2:#EAF2F9;
    --row-alt:#FAFCFE;
    --border:#E1EBF3;
    --border-strong:#C7DCEC;
    --blue:#0D5FC4;
    --blue-2:#0080F0;
    --blue-light:#4FB3FF;
    --blue-dim:#E3F1FF;
    --blue-text:#0865BD;
    --teal:#00C2A8;
    --teal-dim:#DFF7F2;
    --teal-text:#03937E;
    --amber:#C97F1E;
    --amber-dim:#FBF0DE;
    --violet:#6B5FC9;
    --violet-dim:#EDEBFA;
    --rose:#D64545;
    --rose-dim:#FBEAEA;
    --rose-text:#B23434;
    --slate:#5B7083;
    --slate-dim:#E9EEF2;
    --slate-text:#3E5464;
    --danger:#D64545;
    --danger-dim:#FBEAEA;
    --text-primary:#0C2C42;
    --text-secondary:#48708A;
    --text-muted:#8AA6B8;
    --toast-bg:#0C2C42;
    --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(20,80,140,0.04);
    --shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(20,80,140,0.05), 0 12px 28px rgba(20,80,140,0.07);
    --shadow-hover: 0 4px 10px rgba(20,80,140,0.07), 0 18px 38px rgba(20,80,140,0.11);
    --radius: 16px;
    --surface-translucent: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);
  }
  html[data-theme="dark"]{
    --bg:#0A1420;
    --surface:#111C2B;
    --surface-2:#17263A;
    --row-alt:#0E1826;
    --border:#213348;
    --border-strong:#2C4360;
    --blue:#4FB3FF;
    --blue-2:#3C9DFF;
    --blue-light:#8AD0FF;
    --blue-dim:#173250;
    --blue-text:#7FC8FF;
    --teal:#2FE0C4;
    --teal-dim:#0F3A34;
    --teal-text:#5CEBD3;
    --amber:#E7AE5C;
    --amber-dim:#3B2B14;
    --violet:#A79BF0;
    --violet-dim:#26213F;
    --rose:#F17E7E;
    --rose-dim:#3A1717;
    --rose-text:#FF9C9C;
    --slate:#9AB0C4;
    --slate-dim:#1E2C3B;
    --slate-text:#C1D2E1;
    --danger:#F17E7E;
    --danger-dim:#3A1717;
    --text-primary:#EAF3FB;
    --text-secondary:#9DB6CB;
    --text-muted:#647F96;
    --toast-bg:#1B2E42;
    --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    --shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.25), 0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
    --shadow-hover: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.3), 0 18px 38px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
    --surface-translucent: rgba(17,28,43,0.72);
  }
  html[data-theme="dark"] body{background:var(--bg);}
  html[data-theme="dark"] .kpi-card, html[data-theme="dark"] .panel, html[data-theme="dark"] .modal-card{border-color:var(--border);}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){
    html{transition:background-color .25s ease;}
  }
  *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
  html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
  body{
    background:var(--bg);
    color:var(--text-primary);
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif;
    min-height:100vh;
    padding:0 0 48px;
    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  }
  .num{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}
  .wrap{max-width:1900px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 clamp(20px,3vw,44px);}
  svg.icon{width:18px;height:18px;stroke:currentColor;fill:none;stroke-width:1.9;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}

  @keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .fade{animation:none !important;} }
  .fade{animation:fadeUp .5s ease both;}
  .d1{animation-delay:.03s;} .d2{animation-delay:.08s;} .d3{animation-delay:.13s;} .d4{animation-delay:.18s;}

  /* Hero header */
  .hero{
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    background:
      radial-gradient(1200px 500px at 8% -20%, rgba(255,255,255,0.14), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(900px 500px at 105% 10%, rgba(255,255,255,0.10), transparent 55%),
      linear-gradient(120deg, #063B73 0%, var(--blue) 28%, var(--blue-2) 58%, var(--teal) 100%);
    padding:40px 0 76px;
    margin-bottom:-46px;
  }
  .hero-pattern{position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.09;pointer-events:none;}
  header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;position:relative;z-index:2;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:18px;}
  .brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;}
  .brand-mark{
    width:104px;height:104px;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 18px rgba(2,20,40,0.35));
    flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .brand-mark img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;}
  .brand-text h1{font-size:32px;font-weight:700;color:#FFFFFF;line-height:1.15;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;direction:rtl;}
  .brand-text p{font-size:13.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.88);margin-top:7px;font-weight:500;}
  .brand-abbr{
    font-size:15px;font-weight:500;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.75);
    margin-inline-start:10px;padding-inline-start:12px;
    padding-block:6px;
    border-inline-start:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
    letter-spacing:.03em;
  }
  .header-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .header-icons{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding-inline-start:14px;border-inline-start:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.28);}
  .header-pills{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .theme-toggle{
    width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.16);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.32);
    color:#FFFFFF;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;
    backdrop-filter:blur(6px);transition:background .18s ease, transform .18s ease;
  }
  .theme-toggle:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.28);}
  .theme-toggle svg{width:18px;height:18px;}
  .lang-toggle{
    width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.16);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.32);
    color:#FFFFFF;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;
    backdrop-filter:blur(6px);transition:background .18s ease, transform .18s ease;
    font-family:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;line-height:1;padding:0;
  }
  .lang-toggle:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.28);}
  .lang-toggle span{display:inline-block;}
  .live-pill{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.16);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.32);
    padding:9px 16px;border-radius:20px;font-size:12.5px;color:#FFFFFF;font-weight:600;
    backdrop-filter:blur(6px);
  }
  .live-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#8CFFDD;box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(140,255,221,.6);animation:pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;}
  @keyframes pulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(140,255,221,.5);}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px rgba(140,255,221,0);}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(140,255,221,0);}}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .live-dot{animation:none} }
  .date-txt{font-size:12.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.82);font-weight:500;}
  .hero-sub{position:relative;z-index:2;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.92);font-size:13.5px;margin-top:24px;max-width:680px;line-height:1.8;}

  .hero-stats{
    position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:26px;
  }
  .hero-stat{
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.13);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.24);
    backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border-radius:14px;padding:14px 20px;min-width:140px;
  }
  .hero-stat-value{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:#FFFFFF;line-height:1;}
  .hero-stat-label{font-size:11px;color:rgba(255,255,255,0.78);margin-top:6px;font-weight:500;}

  /* KPI Strip */
  .kpi-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;margin-bottom:18px;position:relative;z-index:3;}
  .kpi-card{
    position:relative;overflow:hidden;
    background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);
    padding:21px 22px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);
    transition:transform .22s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow .22s ease;
  }
  .kpi-card::before{
    content:'';position:absolute;top:0;right:0;left:0;height:3px;
    background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue-2),var(--blue-light));
    opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s ease;
  }
  .kpi-card:hover::before{opacity:1;}
  .kpi-card.c-teal::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal),#5FD4B4);}
  .kpi-card.c-amber::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--amber),#E8B968);}
  .kpi-card.c-violet::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--violet),#9B90E0);}
  .kpi-card.c-rose::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--rose),#E8837F);}
  .kpi-card.c-slate::before{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--slate),#8FA5B7);}
  .kpi-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover);}
  .kpi-badge{transition:transform .22s ease;}
  .kpi-card:hover .kpi-badge{transform:scale(1.08) rotate(-4deg);}
  .kpi-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;}
  .kpi-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-secondary);font-weight:600;}
  .kpi-badge{
    width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .kpi-card.c-blue .kpi-badge{background:var(--blue-dim);color:var(--blue-text);}
  .kpi-card.c-teal .kpi-badge{background:var(--teal-dim);color:var(--teal-text);}
  .kpi-card.c-amber .kpi-badge{background:var(--amber-dim);color:var(--amber);}
  .kpi-card.c-violet .kpi-badge{background:var(--violet-dim);color:var(--violet);}
  .kpi-card.c-rose .kpi-badge{background:var(--rose-dim);color:var(--rose-text);}
  .kpi-card.c-slate .kpi-badge{background:var(--slate-dim);color:var(--slate-text);}
  .kpi-value{font-size:29px;font-weight:700;margin-top:16px;color:var(--text-primary);line-height:1;}
  .kpi-unit{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-right:5px;font-weight:400;}
  .kpi-foot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:14px;}
  .kpi-delta{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-muted);}
  .kpi-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:20px;}
  .kpi-card.c-blue .kpi-chip{background:var(--blue-dim);color:var(--blue-text);}
  .kpi-card.c-teal .kpi-chip{background:var(--teal-dim);color:var(--teal-text);}
  .kpi-card.c-amber .kpi-chip{background:var(--amber-dim);color:var(--amber);}
  .kpi-card.c-violet .kpi-chip{background:var(--violet-dim);color:var(--violet);}
  .kpi-card.c-rose .kpi-chip{background:var(--rose-dim);color:var(--rose-text);}
  .kpi-card.c-slate .kpi-chip{background:var(--slate-dim);color:var(--slate-text);}
  .kpi-track{height:4px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--surface-2);margin-top:12px;overflow:hidden;}
  .kpi-track-fill{height:100%;border-radius:3px;}
  .kpi-card.c-blue .kpi-track-fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue-2),var(--blue-light));}
  .kpi-card.c-teal .kpi-track-fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal),#5FD4B4);}
  .kpi-card.c-amber .kpi-track-fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--amber),#E8B968);}
  .kpi-card.c-violet .kpi-track-fill{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--violet),#9B90E0);}

  /* Panels */
  .main-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:16px;}
  .panel{
    background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:24px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  }
  .panel-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;}
  .panel-head-left{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;}
  .panel-icon{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--blue-dim);color:var(--blue-text);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;}
  .panel-title{font-size:14px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-primary);}
  .panel-sub{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:3px;}
  .chart-wrap{position:relative;height:250px;}

  .bottom-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:16px;}

  /* Insights list */
  .insight-item{display:flex;gap:13px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
  .insight-item:last-child{border-bottom:none;padding-bottom:0;}
  .insight-item:first-child{padding-top:0;}
  .insight-icon{
    width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;flex-shrink:0;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    background:var(--blue-dim);color:var(--blue-text);
  }
  .insight-title{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-primary);}
  .insight-meta{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:3px;}

  /* Completion mini bars */
  .comp-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;}
  .comp-name{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-secondary);width:155px;flex-shrink:0;font-weight:500;}
  .comp-track{flex:1;height:8px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--surface-2);overflow:hidden;}
  .comp-fill{height:100%;border-radius:5px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue-2),var(--teal));transition:width .6s ease;}
  .comp-pct{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-primary);font-weight:700;width:38px;text-align:left;}

  /* Table */
  .table-scroll{overflow-x:auto;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid var(--border);}
  .table-footer-bar{
    display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
    margin-top:14px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);
    font-size:12px;color:var(--text-secondary);
  }
  table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.5px;}
  th{
    text-align:right;font-weight:700;color:var(--blue-text);font-size:11.5px;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif;
    padding:11px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);white-space:nowrap;
    background:var(--blue-dim);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2;
  }
  td{padding:11px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);white-space:normal;word-break:keep-all;color:var(--text-primary);}
  .task-cell{white-space:normal;line-height:1.5;min-width:220px;}
  th.sortable{cursor:pointer;user-select:none;transition:background .15s ease,color .15s ease;}
  th.sortable:hover{filter:brightness(1.15);}
  th.sortable .sort-arrow{display:inline-block;margin-right:5px;opacity:.35;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:-2px;}
  th.sortable.active{background:var(--blue-dim);color:var(--blue-text);}
  th.sortable.active .sort-arrow{opacity:1;color:var(--blue-2);}
  th.sortable.active.dir-asc .sort-arrow::before{content:'▲';}
  th.sortable.active.dir-desc .sort-arrow::before{content:'▼';}
  th.sortable:not(.active) .sort-arrow::before{content:'▲▼';}
  th.sortable.active .sort-arrow{font-size:9px;}
  tbody tr.row-cancelled{background:linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(214,69,69,.06), transparent 40%);}
  tbody tr.row-cancelled:hover{background:linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(214,69,69,.12), var(--blue-dim) 60%);}
  tbody tr.row-changeorder td:first-child{box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--slate);}
  .table-toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .col-toggle-wrap{position:relative;}
  .col-toggle-panel{
    display:none;position:absolute;left:0;top:calc(100% + 8px);z-index:10;
    background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:12px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover);padding:10px;min-width:190px;max-height:320px;overflow-y:auto;
  }
  .col-toggle-panel.open{display:block;}
  .col-toggle-item{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 8px;border-radius:8px;
    font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-primary);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .col-toggle-item:hover{background:var(--surface-2);}
  .col-toggle-item input{width:15px;height:15px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .col-toggle-bulk{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:2px 2px 8px;}
  .col-toggle-bulk-btn{
    flex:1;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text-primary);
    border-radius:8px;padding:6px 8px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s ease;
  }
  .col-toggle-bulk-btn:hover{background:var(--border);}
  .col-toggle-sep{height:1px;background:var(--border);margin:0 2px 8px;}
  .btn-delete-row{
    width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);background:var(--surface);
    color:var(--rose-text);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;
    transition:background .15s ease,border-color .15s ease;
  }
  .btn-delete-row:hover{background:var(--rose-dim);border-color:var(--rose);}
  .btn-delete-row svg{width:15px;height:15px;}

  .badge-toggle{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:4px 11px;border-radius:20px;
    font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;border:1px dashed transparent;cursor:pointer;
    background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text-muted);white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .badge-toggle:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong);}
  .badge-toggle.on.f-cancelled{background:var(--rose-dim);color:var(--rose-text);}
  .badge-toggle.on.f-changeOrder{background:var(--slate-dim);color:var(--slate-text);}
  .badge-toggle.on.f-attendanceConfirmed{background:var(--teal-dim);color:var(--teal-text);}
  .badge-toggle.f-attendanceConfirmed.state-confirmed{background:var(--teal-dim);color:var(--teal-text);}
  .badge-toggle.f-attendanceConfirmed.state-unconfirmed{background:var(--slate-dim);color:var(--slate-text);}
  .badge-toggle.f-trainingStatus.st-active{background:var(--teal-dim);color:var(--teal-text);}
  .badge-toggle.f-trainingStatus.st-final{background:var(--blue-dim);color:var(--blue-text);}
  .badge-toggle.f-trainingStatus.st-waiting{background:var(--violet-dim,var(--slate-dim));color:var(--violet,var(--slate-text));}
  .badge-toggle.f-trainingStatus.st-postponed{background:var(--amber-dim);color:var(--amber);}
  .badge-toggle.f-trainingStatus.st-cancelled{background:var(--rose-dim);color:var(--rose-text);}
  .cand-empty{color:var(--text-muted);}
  .editable-cell{cursor:pointer;border-radius:6px;padding:2px 6px;margin:-2px -6px;transition:background .15s ease;}
  .editable-cell:hover, .editable-cell:focus-visible{background:var(--surface-2);}
  .date-cell-input{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-primary);
    background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:7px;
    padding:4px 7px;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s ease,background .15s ease;
    max-width:132px;
  }
  .date-cell-input:hover{border-color:var(--border-strong);background:var(--surface-2);}
  .date-cell-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--blue-2);}
  .tbl-btn{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif;
    border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:9px;
    padding:8px 14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-secondary);
    background:var(--surface);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s, color .15s;
  }
  .tbl-btn:hover{background:var(--blue-dim);color:var(--blue-text);}
  .tbl-btn.active{background:var(--blue-2);color:#fff;border-color:var(--blue-2);}

  /* Modal */
  .modal-overlay{
    display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(12,44,66,0.45);
    backdrop-filter:blur(3px);z-index:100;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;
  }
  .modal-overlay.open{display:flex;}
  .modal-card{
    background:var(--surface);border-radius:18px;max-width:640px;width:100%;
    max-height:88vh;overflow-y:auto;box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(6,30,50,0.35);
    animation:modalIn .22s ease;
  }
  @keyframes modalIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.98);}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1);}}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .modal-card{animation:none;} }
  .modal-head{
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;
    padding:20px 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
    position:sticky;top:0;background:var(--surface);border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;
  }
  .modal-title{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:15px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-primary);}
  .modal-close{
    width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--border-strong);
    background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text-secondary);cursor:pointer;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .15s;
  }
  .modal-close:hover{background:var(--danger-dim);color:var(--danger);}
  .modal-form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;padding:22px 24px;}
  .f-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;}
  .f-field.f-full{grid-column:1/-1;}
  .f-field label{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-secondary);}
  .f-field input, .f-field select{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif;
    border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 13px;
    font-size:13px;color:var(--text-primary);background:var(--surface);outline:none;
    transition:border-color .15s;
  }
  .f-field input:focus, .f-field select:focus{border-color:var(--blue-2);}
  .f-field input:disabled{background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text-muted);}
  .modal-actions{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;margin-top:6px;}

  /* ---- Auth / session ---- */
  .session-pill{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.16);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.32);
    padding:7px 8px 7px 16px;border-radius:22px;font-size:12.5px;color:#FFFFFF;font-weight:600;
    backdrop-filter:blur(6px);cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s ease;
  }
  .session-pill:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.26);}
  .session-avatar{
    width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.24);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;
  }
  .session-avatar svg{width:14px;height:14px;}
  .session-pill .session-logout{
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:22px;height:22px;border-radius:50%;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.14);margin-right:2px;transition:background .15s;
  }
  .session-pill .session-logout:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.32);}
  .session-pill .session-logout svg{width:12px;height:12px;}

  .lock-badge{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    width:15px;height:15px;margin-left:8px;opacity:.85;
  }
  .lock-badge svg{width:13px;height:13px;}
  .btn-delete-row.is-locked{opacity:.55;}

  .auth-gate-note{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:var(--amber-dim);color:var(--amber);
    border:1px solid rgba(201,127,30,0.22);border-radius:11px;padding:10px 14px;
    font-size:12px;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:16px;
  }
  .auth-gate-note svg{width:15px;height:15px;flex-shrink:0;}

  .login-card{max-width:400px;}
  .login-head{
    padding:30px 28px 6px;text-align:center;position:relative;
  }
  .login-close{
    position:absolute;top:12px;inset-inline-end:12px;
    width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;
    background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--border);color:var(--text-secondary);
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  }
  .login-close svg{width:15px;height:15px;}
  .login-close:hover{background:var(--row-alt);color:var(--text-primary);}
  .login-badge-icon{
    width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:14px;margin:0 auto 16px;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue-2),var(--teal));color:#fff;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(13,95,196,0.28);
  }
  .login-badge-icon svg{width:24px;height:24px;}
  .login-head h3{font-size:16.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-primary);}
  .login-head p{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-secondary);margin-top:6px;line-height:1.7;}
  .login-form{padding:22px 28px 28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;}
  .login-form .f-field label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;}
  .login-form select, .login-form input{width:100%;}
  .login-error{
    display:none;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--rose-dim);color:var(--rose-text);
    border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;
  }
  .login-error.show{display:flex;}
  .login-error svg{width:14px;height:14px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .login-submit{
    background:var(--blue-2);color:#fff;border:1px solid var(--blue-2);border-radius:10px;
    padding:12px;font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
  }
  .login-submit:hover{background:var(--blue);}
  .login-foot-note{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;justify-content:center;
    font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:2px;
  }
  .login-foot-note svg{width:12px;height:12px;}

  footer{flex-wrap:wrap;row-gap:8px;}
  .foot-meta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .foot-tag{
    display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:var(--surface-2);
    border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:20px;padding:4px 11px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-secondary);
  }
  .foot-tag svg{width:11px;height:11px;}
  .toast{
    position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(20px);
    background:var(--toast-bg);color:#fff;padding:12px 22px;border-radius:12px;
    font-size:13px;font-weight:600;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:all .25s ease;z-index:200;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;
  }
  .toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}
  tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}
  tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:var(--row-alt);}
  tbody tr:hover{background:var(--blue-dim);}
  .status-pill{
    display:inline-block;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;
    background:var(--teal-dim);color:var(--teal-text);vertical-align:middle;
  }
  .mode-pill{
    display:inline-block;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:20px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;vertical-align:middle;
  }
  .mode-pill.internal{background:var(--blue-dim);color:var(--blue-text);}
  .mode-pill.external{background:var(--amber-dim);color:var(--amber);}

  .filter-bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;}
  .filter-input, .filter-select{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif;
    border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:10px;
    padding:10px 14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-primary);background:var(--surface);
    outline:none;transition:border-color .15s;
  }
  .filter-input{flex:1;min-width:220px;}
  .filter-select{min-width:170px;}
  .filter-input:focus, .filter-select:focus{border-color:var(--blue-2);}
  .dept-filter-wrap{position:relative;}
  .dept-filter-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;min-width:170px;cursor:pointer;}
  .dept-filter-panel{
    display:none;position:absolute;right:0;top:calc(100% + 8px);z-index:10;
    background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:12px;
    box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover);padding:10px;min-width:230px;max-height:300px;overflow-y:auto;
  }
  .dept-filter-panel.open{display:block;}
  .dept-filter-item{
    display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:7px 8px;border-radius:8px;
    font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-primary);cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;
  }
  .dept-filter-item:hover{background:var(--surface-2);}
  .dept-filter-item input{width:15px;height:15px;flex-shrink:0;}
  .dept-filter-sep{height:1px;background:var(--border);margin:6px 2px;}
  .filter-reset{
    font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif;
    border:1px solid var(--border-strong);border-radius:10px;
    padding:10px 16px;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-secondary);
    background:var(--surface-2);cursor:pointer;transition:background .15s;
  }
  .filter-reset:hover{background:var(--border);}

  footer{
    margin-top:10px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid var(--border);
    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted);
  }
  footer .foot-brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-secondary);}
  .foot-logo{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;}
  .foot-logo img{width:26px;height:26px;object-fit:contain;}
  .signature{
    text-align:center;font-size:10px;color:var(--text-muted);font-weight:500;
    margin-top:10px;
  }

  /* Back to top */
  .btn-top{
    position:fixed;bottom:26px;left:26px;z-index:50;
    width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:none;cursor:pointer;
    background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue-2),var(--teal));color:#fff;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(13,95,196,0.32);
    opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.85);pointer-events:none;
    transition:opacity .25s ease, transform .25s ease;
  }
  .btn-top.show{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1);pointer-events:auto;}
  .btn-top:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.05);}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .btn-top{transition:opacity .1s;} }

  /* Section navigation dock (horizontal icon toolbar) */
  .section-nav{
    position:sticky;top:14px;z-index:45;
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;
    border-radius:16px;padding:8px;margin-bottom:16px;
    background:rgba(255,255,255,0.14);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.28);
    backdrop-filter:blur(8px);box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(2,20,40,0.18);
    transition:background .25s ease,border-color .25s ease,box-shadow .25s ease,backdrop-filter .25s ease;
  }
  .section-nav-item{
    position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;flex-shrink:0;
    color:rgba(255,255,255,0.9);text-decoration:none;
    transition:background .15s ease,color .15s ease;
  }
  .section-nav-item:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.22);color:#fff;}
  .section-nav-icon svg{width:19px;height:19px;}
  .section-nav-item.active{background:rgba(255,255,255,0.92);color:var(--blue-text);}
  .section-nav-tip{
    position:absolute;top:calc(100% + 9px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-4px);
    background:var(--toast-bg);color:#fff;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;
    padding:5px 11px;border-radius:8px;white-space:nowrap;
    opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .15s ease, transform .15s ease;z-index:20;
  }
  .section-nav-item:hover .section-nav-tip{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0);}

  /* Once the dock is scrolled up and pinned over regular page content, switch to a translucent surface style */
  .section-nav.scrolled{
    background:var(--surface-translucent);border-color:var(--border);
    backdrop-filter:blur(8px);box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  }
  .section-nav.scrolled .section-nav-item{color:var(--text-secondary);}
  .section-nav.scrolled .section-nav-item:hover{background:var(--surface-2);color:var(--text-primary);}
  .section-nav.scrolled .section-nav-item.active{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--blue-2),var(--teal));color:#fff;}

  @media (max-width:900px){ .section-nav{display:none !important;} }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .section-nav, .section-nav-item, .section-nav-tip{transition:none;} }

  /* Panel head icon subtle lift on hover for a livelier feel */
  .panel-icon{transition:transform .2s ease;}
  .panel:hover .panel-icon{transform:translateY(-1px);}

  /* Refined focus ring for accessibility + polish */
  button:focus-visible, input:focus-visible, select:focus-visible, .badge-toggle:focus-visible{
    outline:2px solid var(--blue-2);outline-offset:2px;
  }

  /* Print stylesheet: clean, ink-friendly report */
  @media print{
    :root, html[data-theme="dark"]{
      --bg:#fff; --surface:#fff; --surface-2:#f3f8fc; --row-alt:#fafcfe;
      --border:#e1ebf3; --border-strong:#c7dcec;
      --text-primary:#0C2C42; --text-secondary:#48708A; --text-muted:#8AA6B8;
    }
    body{background:#fff;}
    .hero{background:#fff !important;padding:10px 0 20px;margin-bottom:10px;color:#0C2C42;}
    .hero *{color:#0C2C42 !important;text-shadow:none !important;}
    .hero-pattern, .live-pill, .btn-top, .btn-theme, .theme-toggle, #btnAdd, .table-toolbar, .btn-delete-row, .modal-overlay, .table-footer-bar, .session-pill, .section-nav{display:none !important;}
    .filter-bar{display:none !important;}
    .kpi-card, .panel{box-shadow:none !important;border:1px solid #ccc !important;}
    .table-scroll{overflow:visible !important;}
    table{font-size:11px;}
    th{position:static !important;}
    .wrap{max-width:100% !important;}
    section{break-inside:avoid;}
  }

  @media (max-width:1200px){
    .kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
  }
  @media (max-width:980px){
    .kpi-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}
    .main-grid,.bottom-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  }
</style>

<style id="department-permission-style">
.row-readonly .readonly-cell{opacity:.72;cursor:not-allowed}
.row-readonly .badge-toggle{opacity:.68;cursor:not-allowed}
.row-readonly .btn-delete-row{opacity:.38;cursor:not-allowed}
</style>

<style id="admin-permission-style">
.admin-full-access{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;margin-inline-start:8px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:999px;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;opacity:.72}
</style>

<style id="pro-enhancements">
  /* ===== KPI card 3D tilt ===== */
  .kpi-card{transform-style:preserve-3d;transition:transform .12s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;will-change:transform;}
  .kpi-card.tilting{transition:none;}

  /* ===== Scroll reveal ===== */
  .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(18px);transition:opacity .55s ease, transform .55s ease;}
  .reveal.in-view{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0);}
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .reveal{opacity:1 !important;transform:none !important;transition:none !important;} }
</style>

<style id="pro-enhancements-2">
  /* ===== Accessibility: skip link + focus-visible ===== */
  .skip-link{
    position:fixed;top:-60px;right:16px;z-index:999;
    background:var(--blue-2);color:#fff;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:10px;
    font-size:13px;font-weight:700;box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover);transition:top .18s ease;
  }
  .skip-link:focus{top:16px;}
  :focus-visible{outline:2.5px solid var(--blue-2);outline-offset:2px;border-radius:4px;}

  /* ===== Table empty state ===== */
  .table-empty-state{padding:52px 20px;text-align:center;}
  .table-empty-state svg{width:44px;height:44px;color:var(--text-muted);opacity:.55;margin-bottom:14px;}
  .table-empty-title{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-secondary);}
  .table-empty-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:5px;}

  /* ===== Print styles ===== */
  @media print{
    .hero, .table-toolbar, .filter-bar, #btnTop,
    .modal-overlay, .toast, .signature, #btnAdd, .btn-delete-row, th:last-child, td:last-child{
      display:none !important;
    }
    body{background:#fff;}
    .panel, .kpi-card{box-shadow:none !important;border:1px solid #ccc !important;break-inside:avoid;}
    .table-scroll{overflow:visible !important;border:1px solid #ccc !important;}
    table{font-size:10.5px;}
  }
</style>

<style id="v2-enhancements">
/* ============================================================
   PDC Dashboard — Enterprise Enhancement Layer v2
   ============================================================ */

/* ---------- 1. Sticky table header + frozen first column ---------- */
.table-scroll{ max-height:none; }
#trainingTable thead th{
  position:sticky; top:0; z-index:6;
  background:var(--blue-dim);
  box-shadow:inset 0 -1px 0 var(--border);
}
#trainingTable thead th:first-child{ z-index:8; }
#trainingTable tbody td:first-child{
  position:sticky; right:0; z-index:4;
  background:var(--surface);
  box-shadow:inset -1px 0 0 var(--border);
  font-weight:600;
}
#trainingTable thead th:first-child{
  position:sticky; right:0;
  background:var(--blue-dim);
  box-shadow:inset -1px 0 0 var(--border);
}
#trainingTable tbody tr:nth-child(even) td:first-child{ background:var(--row-alt); }
#trainingTable tbody tr.row-cancelled td:first-child{ background:var(--rose-dim); }

/* ---------- 2. KPI year-over-year delta ---------- */
.v2-delta{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:3px;
  font-size:11px; font-weight:800; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:20px;
  margin-inline-end:6px; letter-spacing:.2px;
}
.v2-delta.up{ background:var(--teal-dim); color:var(--teal-text); }
.v2-delta.down{ background:var(--rose-dim); color:var(--rose-text); }
.v2-delta.flat{ background:var(--slate-dim); color:var(--slate-text); }
.v2-delta svg{ width:11px; height:11px; stroke-width:3; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; }

/* ---------- 3. Generic v2 panel bits ---------- */
.v2-panel-actions{ display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.v2-mini-btn{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
  font:inherit; font-size:12px; font-weight:700;
  padding:7px 12px; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer;
  background:var(--surface); color:var(--text-secondary);
  border:1px solid var(--border-strong); transition:all .16s ease;
}
.v2-mini-btn:hover{ background:var(--blue-dim); color:var(--blue-text); border-color:var(--blue-2); }
.v2-mini-btn.active{ background:var(--blue-2); color:#fff; border-color:var(--blue-2); }
.v2-mini-btn svg{ width:14px; height:14px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; }
.v2-empty{ padding:38px 18px; text-align:center; color:var(--text-muted); font-size:12.5px; }

/* ---------- 4. Budget vs Actual ---------- */
.v2-budget-grid{ display:grid; gap:12px; padding:4px 0 6px; }
.v2-budget-row{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr auto; gap:6px 14px;
  padding:13px 15px; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:13px;
  background:var(--surface); transition:box-shadow .18s ease, transform .18s ease;
}
.v2-budget-row:hover{ box-shadow:var(--shadow); transform:translateY(-1px); }
.v2-budget-name{ font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--text-primary); }
.v2-budget-nums{ font-size:12px; color:var(--text-secondary); white-space:nowrap; }
.v2-budget-nums b{ color:var(--text-primary); }
.v2-budget-bar{
  grid-column:1 / -1; height:9px; border-radius:20px;
  background:var(--slate-dim); overflow:hidden; position:relative;
}
.v2-budget-fill{ height:100%; border-radius:20px; transition:width .7s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); }
.v2-budget-fill.ok{ background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal),var(--blue-2)); }
.v2-budget-fill.warn{ background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--amber),#E8A13C); }
.v2-budget-fill.over{ background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--rose),#F06B6B); }
.v2-budget-pct{ font-size:12px; font-weight:800; }
.v2-budget-pct.ok{ color:var(--teal-text); }
.v2-budget-pct.warn{ color:var(--amber); }
.v2-budget-pct.over{ color:var(--rose-text); }
.v2-budget-edit{
  border:1px dashed var(--border-strong); background:transparent; cursor:pointer;
  border-radius:7px; padding:1px 7px; font:inherit; font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700;
  color:var(--blue-text);
}
.v2-budget-edit:hover{ background:var(--blue-dim); border-style:solid; }
.v2-budget-summary{
  display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:16px; padding:12px 15px; margin-bottom:12px;
  background:var(--blue-dim); border-radius:13px; font-size:12.5px; color:var(--blue-text); font-weight:700;
}
.v2-budget-summary span b{ font-size:14.5px; }

/* ---------- 5. Timeline / Gantt ---------- */
.v2-gantt-wrap{ overflow-x:auto; padding-bottom:6px; }
.v2-gantt{ min-width:820px; }
.v2-gantt-head{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:230px 1fr; gap:10px;
  position:sticky; top:0; background:var(--surface); z-index:3; padding-bottom:8px;
}
.v2-gantt-months{ display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(12,1fr); }
.v2-gantt-month{
  font-size:10.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--text-muted); text-align:center;
  padding:5px 0; border-inline-start:1px solid var(--border);
}
.v2-gantt-row{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:230px 1fr; gap:10px; align-items:center;
  padding:5px 0; border-top:1px solid var(--border);
}
.v2-gantt-label{
  font-size:11.5px; color:var(--text-secondary); white-space:nowrap;
  overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; padding-inline-end:6px;
}
.v2-gantt-label b{ color:var(--text-primary); font-weight:700; }
.v2-gantt-track{ position:relative; height:22px; background:
  repeating-linear-gradient(to left, transparent 0, transparent calc(8.333% - 1px), var(--border) calc(8.333% - 1px), var(--border) 8.333%); border-radius:6px; }
.v2-gantt-bar{
  position:absolute; top:4px; height:14px; border-radius:20px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--blue-2),var(--blue-light));
  cursor:default; box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(13,95,196,.25);
}
.v2-gantt-bar.ext{ background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--violet),#9F93E8); }
.v2-gantt-bar.cancelled{ background:var(--slate); opacity:.5; }
/* --- 30-day upcoming window --- */
.v2-gantt.tl30 .v2-gantt-months{ grid-template-columns:repeat(6,1fr); }
.v2-gantt.tl30 .v2-gantt-track{
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(to left, transparent 0, transparent calc(16.666% - 1px), var(--border) calc(16.666% - 1px), var(--border) 16.666%);
}
.v2-gantt.tl30 .v2-gantt-label{ white-space:normal; line-height:1.45; }
.v2-gantt-bar.urgent{ background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--rose),#E06060); box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(178,52,52,.32); }
.v2-gantt-bar.soon{ background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--amber),#E7C07C); box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(201,127,30,.28); }
.v2-tl-chip{
  display:inline-block; margin-inline-start:6px; padding:1px 7px; border-radius:20px;
  font-size:10.5px; font-weight:800; vertical-align:middle;
}
.v2-tl-chip.urgent{ background:var(--rose-dim); color:var(--rose-text); }
.v2-tl-chip.soon{ background:var(--amber-dim); color:var(--amber); }
.v2-tl-date{ display:block; font-size:10.5px; color:var(--text-muted); font-weight:600; }
tbody tr.row-urgent15 td:first-child{ box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--rose); }
tbody tr.row-urgent15 .task-cell{ color:var(--rose-text); font-weight:700; }
.v2-gantt-legend{ display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--text-secondary); padding-top:10px; }
.v2-gantt-legend i{ width:20px; height:8px; border-radius:20px; display:inline-block; margin-inline-end:5px; vertical-align:middle; }

/* ---------- 6. Notification centre ---------- */
.v2-bell{ position:relative; }
.v2-bell-count{
  position:absolute; top:-5px; inset-inline-start:-5px;
  min-width:17px; height:17px; padding:0 4px; border-radius:20px;
  background:var(--rose); color:#fff; font-size:10px; font-weight:800;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--surface);
}
.v2-alert-panel{
  position:fixed; top:0; inset-inline-end:0; height:100vh; width:min(400px,92vw);
  background:var(--surface); border-inline-start:1px solid var(--border-strong);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover); z-index:1200;
  transform:translateX(104%); visibility:hidden; pointer-events:none;
  transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1), visibility .3s;
  display:flex; flex-direction:column;
}
html[dir="rtl"] .v2-alert-panel{ transform:translateX(-104%); }
.v2-alert-panel.open{ transform:translateX(0) !important; visibility:visible; pointer-events:auto; }
.v2-alert-head{
  padding:18px 18px 14px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:10px;
}
.v2-alert-head h3{ font-size:15px; margin:0; color:var(--text-primary); }
.v2-alert-body{ overflow-y:auto; padding:12px; flex:1; }
.v2-alert{
  display:flex; gap:11px; padding:12px 13px; border-radius:12px; margin-bottom:9px;
  border:1px solid var(--border); background:var(--surface); cursor:pointer;
  transition:all .16s ease;
}
.v2-alert:hover{ border-color:var(--blue-2); box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); transform:translateX(-2px); }
.v2-alert-icon{
  width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:9px; flex:0 0 30px;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
}
.v2-alert-icon svg{ width:15px; height:15px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2.1; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; }
.v2-alert.high .v2-alert-icon{ background:var(--rose-dim); color:var(--rose-text); }
.v2-alert.med .v2-alert-icon{ background:var(--amber-dim); color:var(--amber); }
.v2-alert.low .v2-alert-icon{ background:var(--blue-dim); color:var(--blue-text); }
.v2-alert-title{ font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--text-primary); margin-bottom:3px; }
.v2-alert-sub{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--text-muted); line-height:1.6; }
.v2-backdrop{
  position:fixed; inset:0; background:rgba(6,24,40,.42); backdrop-filter:blur(2px);
  z-index:1150; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity .25s ease;
}
.v2-backdrop.open{ opacity:1; pointer-events:auto; }

/* ---------- 7. Command palette ---------- */
.v2-cmd-overlay{
  position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:1300; display:flex; justify-content:center;
  padding-top:12vh; background:rgba(6,24,40,.5); backdrop-filter:blur(4px);
  opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transition:opacity .18s ease;
}
.v2-cmd-overlay.open{ opacity:1; pointer-events:auto; }
.v2-cmd{
  width:min(620px,92vw); max-height:66vh; background:var(--surface);
  border-radius:18px; border:1px solid var(--border-strong); box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover);
  display:flex; flex-direction:column; overflow:hidden;
  transform:translateY(-12px) scale(.985); transition:transform .18s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
}
.v2-cmd-overlay.open .v2-cmd{ transform:none; }
.v2-cmd-input-wrap{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:15px 18px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); }
.v2-cmd-input-wrap svg{ width:17px; height:17px; fill:none; stroke:var(--text-muted); stroke-width:2; }
#v2CmdInput{
  flex:1; border:0; outline:0; background:transparent; font:inherit;
  font-size:14.5px; color:var(--text-primary);
}
.v2-cmd-hint{ font-size:10.5px; font-weight:700; color:var(--text-muted); border:1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius:6px; padding:2px 6px; }
.v2-cmd-list{ overflow-y:auto; padding:8px; }
.v2-cmd-group{ font-size:10.5px; font-weight:800; color:var(--text-muted); padding:9px 10px 5px; letter-spacing:.4px; }
.v2-cmd-item{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:11px; padding:10px 11px; border-radius:10px; cursor:pointer;
}
.v2-cmd-item.sel{ background:var(--blue-dim); }
.v2-cmd-item .ic{
  width:27px; height:27px; border-radius:8px; background:var(--slate-dim); color:var(--slate-text);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; flex:0 0 27px;
}
.v2-cmd-item.sel .ic{ background:var(--blue-2); color:#fff; }
.v2-cmd-item .ic svg{ width:14px; height:14px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:2; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; }
.v2-cmd-text{ min-width:0; }
.v2-cmd-t{ font-size:12.8px; font-weight:650; color:var(--text-primary); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
.v2-cmd-s{ font-size:11px; color:var(--text-muted); white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }

/* ---------- 8. Hijri secondary date ---------- */
.v2-hijri{
  display:block; font-size:10px; color:var(--text-muted); font-weight:600;
  margin-top:2px; pointer-events:none; letter-spacing:.2px;
}
body:not(.v2-hijri-on) .v2-hijri{ display:none; }

/* ---------- 9. Kiosk mode ---------- */
body.v2-kiosk .section-nav,
body.v2-kiosk .table-toolbar,
body.v2-kiosk .filter-bar,
body.v2-kiosk #secFilter,
body.v2-kiosk #btnAdd,
body.v2-kiosk #btnTop,
body.v2-kiosk .header-icons,
body.v2-kiosk footer{ display:none !important; }
body.v2-kiosk{ cursor:none; }
.v2-kiosk-bar{
  position:fixed; bottom:0; inset-inline:0; height:4px; background:var(--slate-dim); z-index:1400; display:none;
}
body.v2-kiosk .v2-kiosk-bar{ display:block; }
.v2-kiosk-bar i{ display:block; height:100%; width:0; background:var(--blue-2); transition:width .25s linear; }
.v2-kiosk-exit{
  position:fixed; bottom:16px; inset-inline-start:16px; z-index:1401;
  background:var(--toast-bg); color:#fff; padding:8px 14px; border-radius:20px;
  font-size:11.5px; font-weight:700; display:none; opacity:.8;
}
body.v2-kiosk .v2-kiosk-exit{ display:block; }

/* ---------- 10. Executive report (print only) ---------- */
#v2Report{ display:none; }
@media print{
  body.v2-printing-report > *:not(#v2Report){ display:none !important; }
  body.v2-printing-report #v2Report{ display:block !important; }
  #v2Report .rep-cover{
    min-height:96vh; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center;
    text-align:center; page-break-after:always; padding:40px;
  }
  #v2Report .rep-kicker{ font-size:12px; letter-spacing:3px; color:#0D5FC4; font-weight:800; }
  #v2Report .rep-title{ font-size:30px; font-weight:800; margin:16px 0 8px; color:#0C2C42; }
  #v2Report .rep-sub{ font-size:13px; color:#48708A; }
  #v2Report .rep-rule{ width:90px; height:4px; background:#0D5FC4; margin:22px auto; border-radius:4px; }
  #v2Report .rep-meta{ margin-top:40px; font-size:12px; color:#48708A; line-height:2; }
  #v2Report .rep-sign{ margin-top:70px; display:flex; justify-content:space-around; gap:40px; }
  #v2Report .rep-sign div{ border-top:1px solid #0C2C42; padding-top:7px; font-size:12px; width:200px; }
  #v2Report h2{ font-size:16px; color:#0C2C42; border-bottom:2px solid #0D5FC4; padding-bottom:6px; margin:22px 0 12px; }
  #v2Report table{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:11px; }
  #v2Report th,#v2Report td{ border:1px solid #C7DCEC; padding:6px 8px; text-align:right; }
  #v2Report th{ background:#E3F1FF; color:#0C2C42; }
  #v2Report .rep-kpis{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:10px; }
  #v2Report .rep-kpi{ border:1px solid #C7DCEC; border-radius:8px; padding:10px 14px; min-width:150px; }
  #v2Report .rep-kpi b{ display:block; font-size:19px; color:#0D5FC4; }
  #v2Report .rep-kpi span{ font-size:11px; color:#48708A; }
}

/* ---------- 11. Skeleton shimmer ---------- */
@keyframes v2shimmer{ 0%{background-position:200% 0} 100%{background-position:-200% 0} }
.v2-skel{
  color:transparent !important; border-radius:7px;
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--slate-dim) 25%,var(--border) 37%,var(--slate-dim) 63%);
  background-size:200% 100%; animation:v2shimmer 1.15s linear infinite;
}
.v2-skel *{ visibility:hidden; }

/* ---------- 12. Mobile: keep training table identical to desktop (scrolls horizontally) ---------- */
@media (max-width:760px){
  .v2-gantt-head, .v2-gantt-row{ grid-template-columns:130px 1fr; }
}

/* ---------- 13. Link-copy / view toolbar ---------- */
.v2-toolbar-extra{ display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-inline-start:auto; }
@media (max-width:640px){ .v2-toolbar-extra{ margin-inline-start:0; width:100%; } }
</style>

<style id="se-brand-2026">
/* ==========================================================================
   SE 2026 — طبقة الهوية المؤسسية
   مبنية على ألوان شعار "السعودية للطاقة": الموجة من الأزرق العميق
   إلى السماوي إلى الأخضر. تُطبَّق فوق التنسيقات السابقة دون المساس بالمنطق.
   ========================================================================== */

:root{
  /* ألوان العلامة المستخرجة من الشعار */
  --se-ink:#04182F;
  --se-ink-2:#07264A;
  --se-deep:#0B33C0;
  --se-blue:#0080FF;
  --se-cyan:#00A4D7;
  --se-green:#00C389;
  --se-mint:#02EC93;
  --se-wave:linear-gradient(90deg,#0B33C0 0%,#0080FF 36%,#00A4D7 68%,#02EC93 100%);
  --se-wave-v:linear-gradient(180deg,#0B33C0 0%,#0080FF 55%,#00A4D7 100%);
  --font-display:'Readex Pro','IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif;

  /* إعادة تعريف الرموز اللونية للنظام كاملاً */
  --bg:#F4F7FB;
  --surface:#FFFFFF;
  --surface-2:#EEF3FA;
  --row-alt:#FAFCFF;
  --border:#E4EBF4;
  --border-strong:#CFDCEA;
  --blue:#0B33C0;
  --blue-2:#0080FF;
  --blue-light:#5FB8FF;
  --blue-dim:#E9F2FF;
  --blue-text:#0A56C8;
  --teal:#00C389;
  --teal-dim:#E0F7EE;
  --teal-text:#067A55;
  --amber:#B4761B;
  --amber-dim:#FBF1DF;
  --violet:#3F51C9;
  --violet-dim:#EAEDFB;
  --rose:#D14343;
  --rose-dim:#FBEBEB;
  --rose-text:#AE3232;
  --slate:#4E6480;
  --slate-dim:#EAEFF5;
  --slate-text:#3A506B;
  --danger:#D14343;
  --danger-dim:#FBEBEB;
  --text-primary:#04182F;
  --text-secondary:#4A6480;
  --text-muted:#8496AE;
  --toast-bg:#04182F;
  --shadow-sm:0 1px 2px rgba(4,24,47,.04);
  --shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(4,24,47,.03), 0 10px 26px rgba(4,24,47,.05);
  --shadow-hover:0 2px 4px rgba(4,24,47,.05), 0 20px 44px rgba(4,24,47,.10);
  --radius:18px;
  --surface-translucent:rgba(255,255,255,.88);
}

html[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#03101F;
  --surface:#08192C;
  --surface-2:#0E2440;
  --row-alt:#061423;
  --border:#1A3350;
  --border-strong:#27466B;
  --blue:#5FB8FF;
  --blue-2:#3FA0FF;
  --blue-light:#8ACEFF;
  --blue-dim:#0E2A47;
  --blue-text:#79C1FF;
  --teal:#2FDCA5;
  --teal-dim:#0A342A;
  --teal-text:#5AE9BE;
  --amber:#E0A85C;
  --amber-dim:#332512;
  --violet:#8E9BF2;
  --violet-dim:#1C2140;
  --rose:#F08585;
  --rose-dim:#361616;
  --rose-text:#FFA0A0;
  --slate:#93AAC2;
  --slate-dim:#122539;
  --slate-text:#BDD0E2;
  --danger:#F08585;
  --danger-dim:#361616;
  --text-primary:#E9F2FB;
  --text-secondary:#9BB2C9;
  --text-muted:#647E99;
  --toast-bg:#0E2440;
  --shadow-sm:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
  --shadow:0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.2), 0 10px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
  --shadow-hover:0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.3), 0 20px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.45);
  --surface-translucent:rgba(8,25,44,.88);
}

/* ---------- الطباعة ---------- */
body{ font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Arabic',sans-serif; letter-spacing:0; }
h1, .hero-title, .hero-stat-value, .kpi-value, .panel-title,
.sec-lead-title, .modal-title, .login-head h3, .v2-budget-summary,
.comp-pct, .table-empty-title{
  font-family:var(--font-display);
  letter-spacing:-.012em;
}
.wrap{ max-width:min(2280px, 95vw); padding:0 clamp(18px,2.2vw,44px); }

/* الشاشات العريضة جدًا: وزّع البطاقات على أعمدة أكثر بدل تمديدها */
@media (min-width:1900px){
  .kpi-grid{ grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:16px; }
  .main-grid{ grid-template-columns:1.35fr 1fr; gap:16px; }
  .bottom-grid{ grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:16px; }
  .panel{ padding:30px 30px 28px; }
  .kpi-card{ padding:26px; }
  .kpi-value{ font-size:34px; }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   1 · الواجهة الرئيسية (Hero) — الموجة هي التوقيع البصري
   ========================================================================== */
.hero{
  background:
    radial-gradient(900px 480px at 88% -35%, rgba(0,128,255,.40), transparent 62%),
    radial-gradient(760px 420px at 2% 120%, rgba(0,195,137,.20), transparent 62%),
    linear-gradient(180deg,#04182F 0%, #06213C 58%, #04182F 100%);
  background-color:#04182F;
  padding:24px 0 168px;
  margin-bottom:0;
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);
}
/* الموجة تسكن شريطًا خاصًا بها أسفل الواجهة، فلا تمر خلف أي نص */
.hero-wave{
  position:absolute; inset:auto 0 -1px 0; width:100%; height:158px;
  pointer-events:none; opacity:1;
}
.hero-body, .hero-stats{ position:relative; z-index:2; }
.hero-wave .wv{ fill:none; stroke-linecap:round; }
.hero-wave .wv-lead{ opacity:.92; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference){
  .hero-wave .wv-lead{
    stroke-dasharray:2600; stroke-dashoffset:2600;
    animation:seDraw 1.9s cubic-bezier(.22,.7,.2,1) .15s forwards;
  }
  .hero-wave .wv-echo{ opacity:0; animation:seFadeIn 1.3s ease .7s forwards; }
}
@keyframes seDraw{ to{ stroke-dashoffset:0; } }
@keyframes seFadeIn{ to{ opacity:.5; } }

/* شريط الهوية العلوي */
header{ padding-bottom:22px; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); }
.brand{ gap:18px; }
.brand-mark{
  width:78px; height:78px; padding:0; border-radius:0;
  background:none; box-shadow:none;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 20px rgba(0,150,255,.28));
}
.brand-text h1{ font-size:clamp(20px,2vw,25px); font-weight:600; text-shadow:none; }
.brand-text p{ font-size:12.5px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.62); margin-top:5px; font-weight:400; letter-spacing:.01em; }
.brand-abbr{
  font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:rgba(255,255,255,.62);
  letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase;
}
.live-pill, .session-pill{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  border-radius:999px; font-weight:500; font-size:12px;
}
.live-pill:hover, .session-pill:hover{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.14); }
.live-dot{ background:var(--se-mint); }
.theme-toggle, .lang-toggle{
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.07); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  border-radius:999px; width:36px; height:36px;
}
.theme-toggle:hover, .lang-toggle:hover{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.16); }
.header-icons{ border-inline-start-color:rgba(255,255,255,.14); }

/* مبدّل الصفحات */
.page-switch{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:3px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);
  border-radius:999px; padding:4px;
}
.page-switch-item{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  padding:8px 20px; border-radius:999px; border:none;
  background:none; font-family:inherit;
  font-size:12.5px; font-weight:500; line-height:1;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.68); text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap;
  cursor:pointer; -webkit-appearance:none; appearance:none;
  transition:background .18s ease, color .18s ease;
}
.page-switch-item:not(.is-current):hover{ background:rgba(255,255,255,.14); color:#FFFFFF; }
.page-switch-item.is-current{
  background:#FFFFFF; color:var(--se-ink); font-weight:600; cursor:default;
}
.page-switch-item:focus-visible{ outline:2px solid #FFFFFF; outline-offset:2px; }
.page-switch-item:disabled{ opacity:1; }

/* جسم الواجهة */
.hero-body{ position:relative; z-index:2; margin-top:44px; max-width:min(980px, 68%); }
.hero-eyebrow{
  display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;
  font-size:11.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.16em;
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.72); margin-bottom:20px;
}
.hero-eyebrow-dash{
  display:block; width:46px; height:2px; border-radius:2px;
  background:var(--se-wave); flex-shrink:0;
}
.hero-title{
  font-size:clamp(28px,3.9vw,50px);
  font-weight:600; line-height:1.24; color:#FFFFFF;
  letter-spacing:-.02em;
}
.hero-title .accent{
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#5FB8FF 0%,#00C4BA 52%,#02EC93 100%);
  -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent;
}
.hero-sub{
  color:rgba(255,255,255,.66); font-size:14px; line-height:1.95;
  margin-top:20px; max-width:720px;
}

/* شريط الأرقام: دفتر أرقام بخطوط فاصلة بدل البطاقات الزجاجية */
.hero-stats{
  display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:0; margin-top:46px; padding-top:26px;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);
}
.hero-stat{
  background:none; border:none; backdrop-filter:none; border-radius:0;
  padding:2px 26px 2px 0; min-width:0;
}
.hero-stat:not(:last-child){ border-inline-end:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12); }
.hero-stat:not(:first-child){ padding-inline-start:26px; }
.hero-stat-value{
  font-size:clamp(24px,2.8vw,36px); font-weight:600; color:#FFFFFF;
  line-height:1.05; letter-spacing:-.02em;
}
.hero-stat-label{
  font-size:11px; color:rgba(255,255,255,.55); margin-top:9px;
  font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.09em;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   2 · شريط التنقل المثبّت
   ========================================================================== */
.section-nav{
  position:sticky; top:12px; z-index:45;
  gap:4px; padding:7px; border-radius:999px;
  margin:22px auto 26px; width:fit-content; max-width:100%;
  background:var(--surface-translucent);
  border:1px solid var(--border);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow);
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(1.4);
}
.section-nav-item{ width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:999px; color:var(--text-muted); }
.section-nav-item:hover{ background:var(--surface-2); color:var(--text-primary); }
.section-nav-item.active,
.section-nav.scrolled .section-nav-item.active{
  background:var(--se-wave); color:#fff;
  box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(0,128,255,.28);
}
.section-nav.scrolled{
  background:var(--surface-translucent); border-color:var(--border-strong);
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-hover);
}
.section-nav.scrolled .section-nav-item{ color:var(--text-muted); }
.section-nav-tip{
  background:var(--se-ink); border-radius:8px; font-weight:500;
  letter-spacing:.01em; box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(4,24,47,.24);
}

/* ==========================================================================
   3 · عناوين الأقسام — الأداة الهيكلية الجديدة
   ========================================================================== */
.sec-lead{
  display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:16px;
  margin:38px 0 18px;
}
.sec-lead:first-of-type{ margin-top:8px; }
.sec-lead-dash{
  width:4px; align-self:stretch; min-height:40px; border-radius:4px;
  background:var(--se-wave-v); flex-shrink:0;
}
.sec-lead-title{
  font-size:19px; font-weight:600; color:var(--text-primary); line-height:1.3;
}
.sec-lead-sub{
  font-size:12.5px; color:var(--text-muted); margin-top:6px; line-height:1.7; max-width:620px;
}
.sec-lead--teal .sec-lead-dash{ background:var(--teal); }
.sec-lead--teal .sec-lead-title{ color:var(--teal-text); }
.sec-lead--amber .sec-lead-dash{ background:var(--amber); }
.sec-lead--amber .sec-lead-title{ color:var(--amber-text, var(--amber)); }
.sec-lead--violet .sec-lead-dash{ background:var(--violet); }
.sec-lead--violet .sec-lead-title{ color:var(--violet-text, var(--violet)); }
.sec-lead--slate .sec-lead-dash{ background:var(--slate); }
.sec-lead--slate .sec-lead-title{ color:var(--slate-text); }

/* لمسة لونية خفيفة لألواح الميزانية/الجدول الزمني/سجل التعديلات (مضافة ديناميكيًا) */
#v2SecBudget{ border-inline-start:3px solid var(--slate); }
#v2SecBudget .panel-title{ color:var(--slate-text); }
#v2SecTimeline{ border-inline-start:3px solid var(--blue); }
#v2SecTimeline .panel-title{ color:var(--blue-text); }
#secAudit{ border-inline-start:3px solid var(--rose); }
#secAudit .panel-title{ color:var(--rose-text); }

/* ==========================================================================
   4 · البطاقات واللوحات
   ========================================================================== */
.kpi-grid{ gap:14px; margin-bottom:0; }
.kpi-card{
  border-radius:16px; padding:22px 22px 20px;
  box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm); border:1px solid var(--border);
  transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), box-shadow .25s ease, border-color .25s ease;
}
.kpi-card:hover{ transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:var(--shadow); border-color:var(--border-strong); }
.kpi-card::before{ height:2px; background:var(--se-wave); }
.kpi-card.c-teal::before{ background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal),var(--se-mint)); }
.kpi-card.c-amber::before{ background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--amber),#E0B472); }
.kpi-card.c-rose::before{ background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--rose),#E58585); }
.kpi-card.c-slate::before{ background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--slate),#8FA5BE); }
.kpi-card.c-violet::before{ background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--violet),#8E9BF2); }
.kpi-label{ font-size:11.5px; font-weight:500; color:var(--text-muted); letter-spacing:.02em; }
.kpi-badge{ width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:10px; }
.kpi-value{ font-size:31px; font-weight:600; margin-top:18px; letter-spacing:-.025em; }
.kpi-unit{ font-size:12px; font-weight:400; color:var(--text-muted); }
.kpi-delta{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--text-muted); }
.kpi-chip{ border-radius:6px; font-size:10.5px; font-weight:600; padding:3px 8px; }
.kpi-track{ height:3px; background:var(--surface-2); }
.kpi-card.c-blue .kpi-track-fill{ background:var(--se-wave); }
.kpi-card.c-teal .kpi-track-fill{ background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal),var(--se-mint)); }

.panel{
  border-radius:var(--radius); padding:26px 26px 24px;
  border:1px solid var(--border); box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);
  transition:box-shadow .25s ease, border-color .25s ease;
}
.panel:hover{ box-shadow:var(--shadow); }
.panel-head{ margin-bottom:22px; padding-bottom:16px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); }
.panel-head-left{ gap:13px; }
.panel-icon{
  width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:10px;
  background:var(--blue-dim); color:var(--blue-text);
}
.panel-title{ font-size:15.5px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.01em; }
.panel-sub{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--text-muted); margin-top:4px; }
.main-grid, .bottom-grid{ gap:14px; margin-bottom:14px; }

.insight-icon{ border-radius:10px; }
.insight-title{ font-size:13px; font-weight:600; }
.comp-fill{ background:var(--se-wave); }
.comp-pct{ font-weight:600; }

/* ==========================================================================
   5 · الجدول
   ========================================================================== */
.table-scroll{ border-radius:14px; border:1px solid var(--border); }
th{
  background:var(--surface); color:var(--text-secondary);
  font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.04em;
  padding:14px 12px; border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--border-strong);
}
th.sortable.active{ background:var(--blue-dim); color:var(--blue-text); }
th.sortable.active .sort-arrow{ color:var(--blue-2); }
td{ padding:12px; font-size:12.5px; }
tbody tr{ transition:background .14s ease; }
tbody tr:nth-child(even){ background:var(--row-alt); }
tbody tr:hover{ background:var(--blue-dim); }
.status-pill, .mode-pill, .badge-toggle{ border-radius:6px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.01em; }
.tbl-btn{ border-radius:10px; font-weight:500; }
.tbl-btn:hover{ background:var(--blue-dim); color:var(--blue-text); border-color:var(--blue-light); }
.filter-input, .filter-select, .filter-reset, .f-field input, .f-field select{ border-radius:10px; }
.filter-input:focus, .filter-select:focus, .f-field input:focus, .f-field select:focus{
  border-color:var(--blue-2); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(0,128,255,.12);
}

/* الأزرار الأساسية تحمل تدرّج العلامة */
/* أزرار الإجراء: تدرّج الموجة بعد حذف الطرف الأخضر */
#btnAdd, .login-submit, #addForm button[type="submit"]{
  background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0B33C0 0%,#0080FF 48%,#00A4D7 100%) !important;
  border-color:transparent !important;
  color:#fff !important;
  box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,128,255,.26);
}
#btnAdd:hover, .login-submit:hover, #addForm button[type="submit"]:hover{
  filter:brightness(1.06);
  box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(0,128,255,.34);
}
.btn-top{ background:linear-gradient(90deg,#0B33C0 0%,#0080FF 48%,#00A4D7 100%); box-shadow:0 8px 22px rgba(0,128,255,.32); }
.login-badge-icon{ background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0B33C0 0%,#0080FF 55%,#00A4D7 100%); border-radius:16px; box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,128,255,.28); }
.modal-card{ border-radius:20px; }

/* ==========================================================================
   6 · التذييل
   ========================================================================== */
footer{
  position:relative; margin-top:46px; padding-top:26px;
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
}
footer::before{
  content:''; position:absolute; top:-1px; right:0;
  width:120px; height:2px; border-radius:2px; background:var(--se-wave);
}
footer .foot-brand{ font-size:12.5px; font-weight:600; color:var(--text-primary); }
.foot-logo img{ width:30px; height:30px; }
.foot-tag{ border-radius:6px; }
.signature{ margin-top:14px; letter-spacing:.04em; }

/* ==========================================================================
   7 · استجابة الشاشات
   ========================================================================== */
@media (max-width:1100px){
  .hero-stats{ grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)); row-gap:24px; }
  .hero-stat:nth-child(2){ border-inline-end:none; }
  .hero-stat:nth-child(3){ padding-inline-start:0; }
  .hero-stat:nth-child(3), .hero-stat:nth-child(4){ padding-top:22px; border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10); }
  .hero-stat:nth-child(4){ padding-inline-start:26px; }
}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .hero{ padding:20px 0 104px; }
  .hero-wave{ height:96px; }
  .brand-mark{ width:58px; height:58px; }
  .hero-body{ margin-top:32px; }
  .hero-stats{ margin-top:34px; }
  .sec-lead-title{ font-size:17px; }
  .page-switch-item{ padding:8px 15px; font-size:12px; }
  .panel{ padding:20px; }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  .hero-wave .wv-lead{ animation:none; stroke-dashoffset:0; }
  .hero-wave .wv-echo{ animation:none; opacity:.5; }
  .kpi-card:hover{ transform:none; }
}

/* الطباعة الورقية: خلفية بيضاء ونصوص داكنة */
@media print{
  .hero{ background:#fff !important; border-bottom:2px solid #0080FF; }
  .hero-wave, .section-nav, .sec-lead-dash{ display:none !important; }
  .hero-title, .hero-eyebrow, .hero-stat-value, .hero-stat-label, .hero-sub{ color:#04182F !important; }
  .hero-stats{ border-top-color:#CFDCEA; }
  .hero-stat:not(:last-child){ border-inline-end-color:#CFDCEA; }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   8 · سجل التعديلات (يظهر للمسؤول فقط)
   ========================================================================== */
.audit-tools{ display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; }
.audit-tools .filter-select{ min-width:150px; }
.audit-count{ font-size:11.5px; color:var(--text-muted); margin-bottom:12px; }
.audit-scroll{ max-height:460px; overflow:auto; }
.audit-table{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; }
.audit-table th{ position:sticky; top:0; z-index:2; white-space:nowrap; }
.audit-table td{ font-size:12px; vertical-align:middle; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); }
.audit-time{ white-space:nowrap; color:var(--text-muted); font-size:11.5px; direction:ltr; text-align:right; }
.audit-task{ font-weight:500; max-width:280px; }
.audit-from{ color:var(--text-muted); text-decoration:line-through; }
.audit-to{ color:var(--text-primary); font-weight:500; }
.audit-admin{
  display:inline-block; margin-inline-start:6px; padding:2px 7px; border-radius:5px;
  font-size:10px; font-weight:600; background:var(--violet-dim); color:var(--violet);
}
.audit-action{
  display:inline-block; padding:3px 9px; border-radius:6px;
  font-size:11px; font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap;
}
.audit-action.a-add{ background:var(--teal-dim); color:var(--teal-text); }
.audit-action.a-edit{ background:var(--blue-dim); color:var(--blue-text); }
.audit-action.a-del{ background:var(--rose-dim); color:var(--rose-text); }
.audit-action.a-status{ background:var(--amber-dim); color:var(--amber); }
.audit-action.a-attendance{ background:var(--slate-dim); color:var(--slate-text); }
.audit-action.a-budget{ background:var(--violet-dim); color:var(--violet); }
.audit-empty{
  text-align:center; padding:38px 16px; color:var(--text-muted); font-size:12.5px;
}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .audit-tools{ width:100%; }
  .audit-tools .filter-select{ flex:1 1 130px; min-width:0; }
}

/* ---------- وضع المعاينة المحلي ---------- */
.offline-notice{
  display:flex; align-items:flex-start; gap:9px;
  padding:11px 13px; margin-bottom:14px;
  border-radius:11px; border:1px solid var(--amber);
  background:var(--amber-dim); color:var(--amber);
  font-size:11.5px; line-height:1.75;
}
.offline-notice svg{ width:15px; height:15px; flex-shrink:0; margin-top:2px; }
.offline-admin{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px;
  font-size:12px; color:var(--text-secondary);
  margin:2px 0 12px; cursor:pointer;
}
.offline-admin input{ width:15px; height:15px; accent-color:var(--blue-2); cursor:pointer; }

</style>

<style id="an-redesign">
/* ============================================================
   قسم التحليلات — تصميم تحريري قائم على "خط التغذية"
   خط رأسي متدرّج بألوان الهوية تتفرّع منه عقد لكل قراءة
   ============================================================ */
.an-band{
  position:relative;
  margin:36px 0 28px;
  padding:32px 48px 36px 6px;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(11,51,192,.038) 0%, rgba(0,164,215,.018) 48%, transparent 100%);
  border-top:1px solid var(--border);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);
}
html[data-theme="dark"] .an-band{
  background:linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(95,184,255,.07) 0%, rgba(47,220,165,.03) 48%, transparent 100%);
}
.an-rail{
  position:absolute; top:30px; bottom:30px; right:20px; width:2px;
  background:var(--se-wave-v); opacity:.5; border-radius:2px;
}
.an-node{
  position:absolute; right:-29.5px; top:.5em;
  width:9px; height:9px; border-radius:50%;
  background:var(--surface); border:2px solid var(--blue-2);
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px var(--bg);
}
.an-head, .an-cap{position:relative;}

.an-eyebrow{
  margin:0 0 12px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; color:var(--blue-text);
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px;
}
.an-eyebrow::after{
  content:''; flex:0 0 26px; height:2px; border-radius:2px;
  background:var(--se-wave); opacity:.85;
}
.an-title{
  margin:0; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:600;
  font-size:clamp(23px,3.2vw,36px); line-height:1.35;
  color:var(--text-primary);
}
.an-lede{
  margin:14px 0 0; max-width:62ch;
  font-size:14.5px; line-height:1.85; color:var(--text-secondary);
}
.an-lede strong{color:var(--text-primary); font-weight:600;}
.an-lede .num{color:var(--blue-text); font-weight:600;}

.an-row{display:grid; gap:36px; margin-top:32px;}
.an-row--split{grid-template-columns:1.45fr 1fr;}
.an-row + .an-row{padding-top:32px; border-top:1px solid var(--border);}

.an-fig{margin:0; min-width:0;}
.an-cap{display:block; margin-bottom:18px;}
.an-cap-t{
  display:block; font-family:var(--font-display); font-weight:500;
  font-size:15.5px; color:var(--text-primary);
}
.an-cap-s{display:block; margin-top:5px; font-size:11.5px; color:var(--text-muted);}

.an-band .chart-wrap{height:250px;}
.an-band .chart-wrap--donut{height:186px;}

/* مفتاح التصنيفات: قائمة قيم بدل وسيلة الإيضاح الافتراضية */
.an-legend{margin-top:16px;}
.an-legend-row{
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;
  padding:7px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border); font-size:12px;
}
.an-legend-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.an-legend-dot{width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:2px; flex-shrink:0;}
.an-legend-name{flex:1; min-width:0; color:var(--text-secondary);
  overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap;}
.an-legend-val{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;
  font-weight:600; color:var(--text-primary);}
.an-legend-pct{width:40px; text-align:left; font-size:11px; color:var(--text-muted);
  font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;}

/* ترتيب الإدارات: صفوف بخطوط شعرية بدل مربّعات */
.an-band .comp-row{gap:16px; padding:10px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);}
.an-band .comp-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.an-band .comp-name{width:215px; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:500; color:var(--text-primary);}
.an-band .comp-track{height:3px; border-radius:0; background:var(--surface-2);}
.an-band .comp-fill{border-radius:0; background:var(--se-wave);}
.an-band .comp-pct{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}

/* الملاحظات: بلا صندوق داخل القسم */
.an-band .insight-item{padding:13px 0;}
.an-band .insight-item:first-child{padding-top:0;}
.an-band .insight-icon{width:34px; height:34px; border-radius:9px;}

@media (max-width:900px){
  .an-band{padding:26px 34px 28px 2px;}
  .an-rail{right:14px;}
  .an-node{right:-23.5px;}
  .an-row, .an-row--split{grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:28px;}
  .an-band .comp-name{width:118px;}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){ .an-band .comp-fill{transition:none;} }
@media print{
  .an-band{border:none; background:none; padding-right:0;}
  .an-rail, .an-node{display:none;}
  .an-row{break-inside:avoid; page-break-inside:avoid;}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- مخزن الشعار: يُقرأ منه شعار الصفحة الرئيسية وصفحة المركبات -->
<div id="heroBanner" style="display:none" aria-hidden="true"><span class="brand-mark"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="شعار السعودية للطاقة"></span></div>

<script id="se-home-boot">
(function(){
  var ENTRY_KEY = 'fk_se_entry_v1';
  var MODE_KEY  = 'fk_se_dashboard_mode_v1';
  var SCOPE_KEY = 'fk_se_budget_scope_v1';
  var showHome, hash = '';
  try{ hash = location.hash || ''; }catch(e){}
  try{
    if (hash === '#home')      showHome = true;
    else if (hash)             showHome = false;
    else                       showHome = (sessionStorage.getItem(ENTRY_KEY) !== 'app');
  }catch(e){ showHome = true; }
  /* هذا الملف يحتوي قسمي المكاتب والمركبات: أي مسار آخر يعود للصفحة الرئيسية */
  if (hash !== '#offices' && hash !== '#vehicles') showHome = true;
  window.SE_HOME_ON = showHome;
  if (showHome) document.documentElement.classList.add('se-home');

  /* صفحة الميزانية: قسم مستقل يعمل على بيانات التدريبات أو الاختبارات */
  var scope = 'training';
  try{ scope = (sessionStorage.getItem(SCOPE_KEY) === 'exam') ? 'exam' : 'training'; }catch(e){}
  window.SE_BUDGET_SCOPE = scope;
  if (hash === '#offices'){
    window.SE_VIEW = 'offices';
    document.documentElement.classList.add('se-view-offices');
  }
  if (hash === '#vehicles'){
    window.SE_VIEW = 'vehicles';
    document.documentElement.classList.add('se-view-vehicles');
  }
  if (hash === '#budget'){
    window.SE_VIEW = 'budget';
    document.documentElement.classList.add('se-view-budget');
    /* محرك الوضع يقرأ هذا المفتاح فيختار مخزن البيانات المناسب */
    try{ sessionStorage.setItem(MODE_KEY, scope); }catch(e){}
  }
  window.SE_SET_BUDGET_SCOPE = function(s){
    try{
      sessionStorage.setItem(SCOPE_KEY, s);
      sessionStorage.setItem(MODE_KEY, s);
      sessionStorage.setItem(ENTRY_KEY, 'app');
    }catch(e){}
    location.hash = '#budget';
    location.reload();
  };
  try{
    var th = localStorage.getItem('fk_sec_dashboard_theme_v1') || 'light';
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', th);
  }catch(e){}
  window.SE_GO = function(mode){
    if (mode === 'budget'){ window.SE_SET_BUDGET_SCOPE(window.SE_BUDGET_SCOPE || 'training'); return; }
    try{
      sessionStorage.setItem(ENTRY_KEY, 'app');
      if (mode !== 'offices' && mode !== 'vehicles') sessionStorage.setItem(MODE_KEY, mode);
    }catch(e){}
    if (mode === 'offices') location.hash = '#offices';
    else if (mode === 'vehicles') location.hash = '#vehicles';
    else location.hash = (mode === 'exam') ? '#exams' : '#trainings';
    location.reload();
  };
  window.SE_GO_HOME = function(){
    try{ sessionStorage.setItem(ENTRY_KEY, 'home'); }catch(e){}
    location.hash = '#home';
    location.reload();
  };
})();
</script>

<style id="se-home-style">
  /* في وضع الصفحة الرئيسية نُخفي اللوحة، مع إبقاء نافذة الدخول والتنبيهات فعّالة */
  html.se-home body > *:not(#seHome):not(#loginModalOverlay):not(#toast){ display:none !important; }
  html.se-home body{ padding:0 !important; overflow:hidden; }
  html.se-home #loginModalOverlay{ z-index:9600; }
  html.se-home #toast{ z-index:9700; }
  #seHome{ display:none; }
  html.se-home #seHome{ display:block; }

  /* الميزانية صارت قسمًا مستقلاً — نُخفيها من صفحتي التدريبات والاختبارات */
  html:not(.se-view-budget) #leadBudget,
  html:not(.se-view-budget) #v2SecBudget,
  html:not(.se-view-budget) .section-nav-item[data-target="v2SecBudget"]{ display:none !important; }

  /* صفحة الميزانية: نعرض لوحة الميزانية وحدها */
  html.se-view-budget #sectionNav,
  html.se-view-budget .hero-stats,
  html.se-view-budget #secKPIs,
  html.se-view-budget #secCharts,
  html.se-view-budget #secFilter,
  html.se-view-budget #secTable,
  html.se-view-budget #v2SecTimeline,
  html.se-view-budget #leadOps,
  html.se-view-budget .sec-lead--teal{ display:none !important; }
