  ];
  /* OFFICES_DATA_END */

  var OFFICE_TYPES = [
    '', 'Employee Office', 'Division Office (DV)', 'Department Mgr Office (DM)',
    'Executive Director (ED)', 'Executive Director (VP)', 'Secretary Office',
    'Meeting Room', 'Open Area'
  ];
  var LS_ROWS   = 'fk_se_offices_rows_v2';
  var LS_SEEDED = 'fk_se_offices_seeded_v2';
  var LS_REQS   = 'fk_se_offices_requests_v2';
  var LS_LOG    = 'fk_se_offices_log_v2';
  var LS_SEEN   = 'fk_se_offices_seen_reqs_v2';
  var PAGE_SIZE = 50;
  var LS_DEMO   = 'fk_se_offices_demo_v2';

  var rows = [], reqs = [], logs = [];
  var filtered = [];
  var sortKey = 'building', sortDir = 'asc';
  var editingId = null, movingId = null;
  var page = 1;
  var reqView = 'pending';

  /* ======================================================================
     ٢ · المخزن
     ====================================================================== */
  function uid(p){ return (p||'o') + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7); }

  var SHORT = {n:'name',e:'empNo',t:'etype',s:'sector',d:'dept',v:'division',
               b:'building',ot:'officeType',o:'officeNo',x:'ext',p:'phone',
               c:'city',cs:'consultant',nt:'notes'};

  function expand(r){
    var out = {};
    for (var k in SHORT) out[SHORT[k]] = r[k] || '';
    out._id = uid();
    return out;
  }

  function readJSON(key, fallback){
    try{
      var raw = localStorage.getItem(key);
      if (!raw) return fallback;
      var v = JSON.parse(raw);
      return v || fallback;
    }catch(e){ return fallback; }
  }
  function writeJSON(key, val){
    try{ localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(val)); }catch(e){}
  }

  /* تنظيف لمرة واحدة للمخزن المحلي */
  var LS_PURGED = 'fk_se_vehicles_demo_purged_v1';
  (function purgeOldDemo(){
    try{
      if (localStorage.getItem(LS_PURGED) === '1') return;
      localStorage.removeItem(LS_ROWS);
      localStorage.removeItem(LS_SEEDED);
      localStorage.setItem(LS_PURGED, '1');
    }catch(e){}
  })();

  function loadRows(){
    var raw = null;
    try{ raw = localStorage.getItem(LS_ROWS); }catch(e){}
    if (raw){
      try{ return JSON.parse(raw) || []; }catch(e){ return []; }
    }
    var seeded = false;
    try{ seeded = localStorage.getItem(LS_SEEDED) === '1'; }catch(e){}
    if (seeded) return [];
    var out = OFFICE_SEED.map(expand);
    try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_SEEDED,'1'); }catch(e){}
    writeJSON(LS_ROWS, out);
    return out;
  }
  function saveRows(){ writeJSON(LS_ROWS, rows); }
  function saveReqs(){ writeJSON(LS_REQS, reqs); }
  function saveLogs(){ writeJSON(LS_LOG, logs.slice(0,200)); }

  function syncRow(id, dept, value){
    try{ if (typeof serverMutate === 'function') serverMutate('offices', id, dept, value); }catch(e){}
  }
  function syncReq(id, dept, value){
    try{ if (typeof serverMutate === 'function') serverMutate('office_requests', id, dept, value); }catch(e){}
  }
  function syncLog(id, dept, value){
    try{ if (typeof serverMutate === 'function') serverMutate('office_log', id, dept, value); }catch(e){}
  }

  function pullState(){
    try{
      if (typeof API_URL === 'undefined') return;
      fetch(API_URL + '?action=state', {method:'GET', cache:'no-store'})
        .then(function(r){ return r.ok ? r.json() : null; })
        .then(function(state){
          if (!state) return;
          var changed = false;
          if (state.offices){
            var srv = Object.keys(state.offices).map(function(k){ return state.offices[k]; })
                            .filter(function(x){ return x && x._id; });
            if (srv.length){ rows = srv; saveRows(); changed = true; }
          }
          if (state.office_requests){
            var sr = Object.keys(state.office_requests).map(function(k){ return state.office_requests[k]; })
                           .filter(function(x){ return x && x._id; });
            if (sr.length){ reqs = sr; saveReqs(); changed = true; }
          }
          if (state.office_log){
            var sl = Object.keys(state.office_log).map(function(k){ return state.office_log[k]; })
                           .filter(function(x){ return x && x._id; });
            if (sl.length){ logs = sl; saveLogs(); changed = true; }
          }
          if (changed){ renderAll(); notifyNew(); }
        }).catch(function(){});
    }catch(e){}
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ٣ · أدوات
     ====================================================================== */
  function esc(s){
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g,'&#39;');
  }
  function toast(msg){
    if (typeof showToast === 'function'){ showToast(msg); return; }
    try{ console.log(msg); }catch(e){}
  }
  function nowStamp(){
    var d = new Date(), p = function(n){ return n<10 ? '0'+n : ''+n; };
    return d.getFullYear()+'-'+p(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+p(d.getDate())+' '+p(d.getHours())+':'+p(d.getMinutes());
  }
  function uniq(list){
    var out = [];
    list.forEach(function(v){ if (v && out.indexOf(v) === -1) out.push(v); });
    return out.sort(function(a,b){ return String(a).localeCompare(String(b),'ar'); });
  }
  function buildingList(){ return uniq(rows.map(function(r){ return r.building; })); }
  function deptList(){
    var base = (typeof AUTHORIZED_USERS !== 'undefined')
      ? AUTHORIZED_USERS.map(function(u){ return u.id; }) : [];
    rows.forEach(function(r){ if (r.dept && base.indexOf(r.dept) === -1) base.push(r.dept); });
    return base;
  }
  function officeTypeList(){
    var base = OFFICE_TYPES.slice();
    rows.forEach(function(r){ if (r.officeType && base.indexOf(r.officeType) === -1) base.push(r.officeType); });
    return base;
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ٤ · الصلاحيات
     ====================================================================== */
  function me(){ try{ return (typeof getCurrentUser === 'function') ? getCurrentUser() : null; }catch(e){ return null; } }
  function authed(){ try{ return (typeof isAuthed === 'function') ? isAuthed() : false; }catch(e){ return false; } }
  function admin(){ try{ return (typeof getIsAdminFlag === 'function') ? getIsAdminFlag() : false; }catch(e){ return false; } }
  function canEdit(r){
    if (!authed()) return false;
    if (admin()) return true;
    var u = me();
    return !!u && r.dept === u;
  }
  function guard(fn){
    if (authed()){ fn(); return; }
    if (typeof requireAuth === 'function'){ requireAuth(fn); return; }
    if (typeof openLoginModal === 'function') openLoginModal();
  }

  function refreshSessionUI(){
    var label = document.getElementById('offSessionLabel');
    var lock  = document.getElementById('offAddLock');
    var note  = document.getElementById('offPermNote');
    var noteT = document.getElementById('offPermNoteText');
    var u = me();
    if (label){
      if (u && authed()){
        var lbl = u;
        try{
          if (typeof AUTHORIZED_USERS !== 'undefined'){
            var f = AUTHORIZED_USERS.filter(function(x){ return x.id === u; })[0];
            if (f) lbl = f.label;
          }
        }catch(e){}
        label.textContent = lbl + (admin() ? ' — مشرف' : '');
      } else {
        label.textContent = 'تسجيل الدخول';
      }
    }
    if (lock) lock.style.display = authed() ? 'none' : '';
    if (note && noteT){
      if (!authed()){
        noteT.textContent = 'أنت في وضع العرض فقط. سجّل الدخول لإضافة أو تعديل بيانات المكاتب.';
        note.style.display = '';
      } else if (!admin()){
        noteT.textContent = 'تستطيع تعديل سجلات إدارتك فقط (' + me() + ')، وأي نقل بين المكاتب أو تغيير للإدارة يُرسل للمشرف للاعتماد.';
        note.style.display = '';
      } else {
        noteT.textContent = 'أنت مشرف: تعديلاتك تُطبَّق مباشرة، وتصلك طلبات الإدارات للاعتماد في «صندوق الاعتماد».';
        note.style.display = '';
      }
    }
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ٥ · الإشعارات
     ====================================================================== */
  function pendingReqs(){
    return reqs.filter(function(q){ return q.status === 'pending'; });
  }
  function myPendingScope(){
    /* المشرف يرى كل الطلبات؛ الإدارة ترى طلباتها والطلبات التي تخص موظفيها */
    var u = me();
    if (admin()) return pendingReqs();
    if (!u) return [];
    return pendingReqs().filter(function(q){ return q.by === u || q.fromDept === u || q.toDept === u; });
  }
  function seenIds(){ return readJSON(LS_SEEN, []); }
  function markSeen(){
    writeJSON(LS_SEEN, pendingReqs().map(function(q){ return q._id; }));
    var bell = document.getElementById('offBell');
    if (bell) bell.classList.remove('has-new');
    renderBell();
  }
  function renderBell(){
    var bell = document.getElementById('offBell');
    var cnt  = document.getElementById('offBellCount');
    var list = myPendingScope();
    if (cnt) cnt.textContent = list.length;
    if (bell){
      if (list.length) bell.classList.add('has-new');
      else bell.classList.remove('has-new');
    }
  }
  function askNotifyPermission(){
    try{
      if (typeof Notification === 'undefined') return;
      if (Notification.permission === 'default') Notification.requestPermission();
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function desktopNotify(title, body){
    try{
      if (typeof Notification !== 'undefined' && Notification.permission === 'granted'){
        new Notification(title, {body: body, tag: 'se-offices'});
      }
    }catch(e){}
  }
  function notifyNew(){
    var seen = seenIds();
    var fresh = myPendingScope().filter(function(q){ return seen.indexOf(q._id) === -1; });
    if (!fresh.length) return;
    var q = fresh[0];
    var msg = fresh.length === 1
      ? ('طلب تغيير مكتب جديد: ' + (q.name || '') + ' — ' + (q.by || ''))
      : ('لديك ' + fresh.length + ' طلبات تغيير مكاتب بانتظار الاعتماد');
    toast('🔔 ' + msg);
    desktopNotify('طلب اعتماد — المكاتب', msg);
    renderBell();
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ٦ · التصفية والترتيب
     ====================================================================== */
  function val(id){ var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value.trim() : ''; }

  function applyFilters(){
    var q    = val('offFSearch').toLowerCase();
    var fB   = val('offFBuilding');
    var fD   = val('offFDept');
    var fV   = val('offFDivision');
    var fT   = val('offFType');
    var fOT  = val('offFOfficeType');
    var fHas = val('offFHas');

    filtered = rows.filter(function(r){
      if (fB  && r.building   !== fB) return false;
      if (fD  && r.dept       !== fD) return false;
      if (fV  && r.division   !== fV) return false;
      if (fT  && (r.etype||'') !== fT) return false;
      if (fOT && (r.officeType||'') !== fOT) return false;
      if (fHas === 'yes' && !r.officeNo) return false;
      if (fHas === 'no'  &&  r.officeNo) return false;
      if (q){
        var hay = [r.name, r.empNo, r.dept, r.division, r.building, r.officeNo,
                   r.officeType, r.ext, r.phone, r.city, r.consultant].join(' ').toLowerCase();
        if (hay.indexOf(q) === -1) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });

    filtered.sort(function(a,b){
      var av = a[sortKey] || '', bv = b[sortKey] || '';
      var c = String(av).localeCompare(String(bv), 'ar');
      if (c === 0) c = String(a.name||'').localeCompare(String(b.name||''),'ar');
      return sortDir === 'asc' ? c : -c;
    });
    var maxPage = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE));
    if (page > maxPage) page = maxPage;
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ٧ · الرسم
     ====================================================================== */
  function renderKPIs(){
    var total = rows.length;
    var withOffice = 0, builds = {}, depts = {};
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      if (r.officeNo) withOffice++;
      if (r.building) builds[r.building] = 1;
      if (r.dept) depts[r.dept] = 1;
    });
    var nB = Object.keys(builds).length, nD = Object.keys(depts).length;
    var pend = myPendingScope().length;
    var set = function(id, v){ var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = v; };

    set('offHeroTotal', total);      set('offHeroBuildings', nB);
    set('offHeroOffices', withOffice); set('offHeroPending', pend);
    set('offKpiTotal', total);       set('offKpiOffices', withOffice);
    set('offKpiNoOffice', total - withOffice);
    set('offKpiBuildings', nB);      set('offKpiPending', pend);
    set('offKpiTotalSub', 'موزّعون على ' + nB + ' مبنى و' + nD + ' إدارة');
    set('offKpiOfficesSub', total ? Math.round(withOffice/total*100) + '% من إجمالي الموظفين' : '—');
    set('offKpiNoOfficeSub', (total - withOffice) ? 'تحتاج استكمال بيانات المكتب' : 'كل السجلات مكتملة');
    set('offKpiDepts', 'عدد الإدارات: ' + nD);
    set('offKpiPendingSub', pend ? 'بانتظار اعتمادك في صندوق الاعتماد' : 'لا توجد طلبات معلقة');
    var bar = document.getElementById('offKpiOfficesBar');
    if (bar) bar.style.width = (total ? Math.round(withOffice/total*100) : 0) + '%';
  }

  function renderDist(){
    function draw(hostId, counts, limit){
      var host = document.getElementById(hostId);
      if (!host) return;
      var keys = Object.keys(counts).sort(function(a,b){ return counts[b]-counts[a]; });
      if (limit) keys = keys.slice(0, limit);
      if (!keys.length){ host.innerHTML = '<div class="veh-empty">لا توجد بيانات</div>'; return; }
      var max = counts[keys[0]] || 1;
      host.innerHTML = keys.map(function(k){
        return '<div class="veh-dist-row">' +
                 '<div class="veh-dist-name" title="' + esc(k) + '">' + esc(k) + '</div>' +
                 '<div class="veh-dist-track"><div class="veh-dist-fill" style="width:' + Math.round(counts[k]/max*100) + '%"></div></div>' +
                 '<div class="veh-dist-val num">' + counts[k] + '</div>' +
               '</div>';
      }).join('');
    }
    var byB = {}, byD = {};
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      var b = r.building || 'غير محدد'; byB[b] = (byB[b]||0)+1;
      var d = r.dept || 'غير محددة';    byD[d] = (byD[d]||0)+1;
    });
    draw('offDistBuilding', byB);
    draw('offDistDept', byD, 12);
  }

  function diffChips(q){
    var out = [];
    function chip(lbl, from, to){
      if ((from||'') === (to||'')) return;
      out.push('<div class="off-chip">' + esc(lbl) + ': <b>' + esc(from || '—') + '</b> <span class="arw">←</span> <b>' + esc(to || '—') + '</b></div>');
    }
    chip('المبنى', q.fromBuilding, q.toBuilding);
    chip('نوع المكتب', q.fromOfficeType, q.toOfficeType);
    chip('رقم المكتب', q.fromOfficeNo, q.toOfficeNo);
    chip('الإدارة', q.fromDept, q.toDept);
    return out.join('');
  }

  function renderReqs(){
    var host = document.getElementById('offReqList');
    var sub  = document.getElementById('offReqSub');
    if (!host) return;
    var all = reqs.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return (b.at||'').localeCompare(a.at||''); });
    if (!admin()){
      var u = me();
      all = all.filter(function(q){ return u && (q.by === u || q.fromDept === u || q.toDept === u); });
    }
    var list = (reqView === 'pending') ? all.filter(function(q){ return q.status === 'pending'; }) : all;

    if (sub){
      var p = all.filter(function(q){ return q.status === 'pending'; }).length;
      sub.textContent = p ? (p + ' طلب بانتظار الاعتماد') : 'لا توجد طلبات معلقة حاليًا.';
    }

    if (!list.length){
      host.innerHTML = '<div class="veh-empty">' +
        '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="m8.5 12.5 2.5 2.5 4.5-5"/></svg>' +
        '<div>' + (reqView === 'pending' ? 'لا توجد طلبات بانتظار الاعتماد.' : 'لا يوجد سجل طلبات بعد.') + '</div></div>';
      return;
    }

    host.innerHTML = list.map(function(q){
      var cls = q.status === 'approved' ? ' is-approved' : (q.status === 'rejected' ? ' is-rejected' : '');
      var badge = q.status === 'pending'
        ? '<span class="veh-badge st-soon">بانتظار الاعتماد</span>'
        : (q.status === 'approved' ? '<span class="veh-badge st-active">معتمد</span>'
                                   : '<span class="veh-badge st-expired">مرفوض</span>');
      var actions = '';
      if (q.status === 'pending' && admin()){
        actions = '<div class="off-req-actions">' +
          '<button type="button" class="off-btn ok" data-ok="' + esc(q._id) + '">' +
            '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m5 13 4 4 10-10"/></svg>اعتماد وتطبيق</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="off-btn no" data-no="' + esc(q._id) + '">' +
            '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg>رفض</button>' +
        '</div>';
      } else if (q.status === 'pending'){
        actions = '<div class="off-req-actions"><span class="off-chip">بانتظار اعتماد المشرف</span></div>';
      } else {
        actions = '<div class="off-req-actions"><span class="off-chip">' +
          (q.status === 'approved' ? 'اعتمده' : 'رفضه') + ': <b>' + esc(q.decidedBy || '—') + '</b> · ' + esc(q.decidedAt || '') +
          (q.decisionNote ? ' · ' + esc(q.decisionNote) : '') + '</span></div>';
      }
      return '<div class="off-req' + cls + '">' +
        '<div class="off-req-top">' +
          '<div class="off-req-name">' + esc(q.name || '—') + '</div>' + badge +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="off-req-meta">الرقم الوظيفي ' + esc(q.empNo || '—') + ' · مقدّم الطلب: ' + esc(q.by || '—') + ' · ' + esc(q.at || '') +
          (q.reason ? ' · السبب: ' + esc(q.reason) : '') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="off-req-diff">' + diffChips(q) + '</div>' +
        actions +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  function renderLog(){
    var host = document.getElementById('offLogList');
    if (!host) return;
    var list = logs.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return (b.at||'').localeCompare(a.at||''); }).slice(0, 50);
    if (!list.length){
      host.innerHTML = '<div class="veh-empty">' +
        '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"/><path d="M12 8v4l3 2"/></svg>' +
        '<div>لا توجد تغييرات مسجّلة بعد.</div></div>';
      return;
    }
    host.innerHTML = list.map(function(g){
      var dot = g.kind === 'reject' ? 'no' : (g.kind === 'approve' ? 'ok' : '');
      return '<div class="off-log-row">' +
        '<span class="off-log-dot ' + dot + '"></span>' +
        '<div><div class="off-log-txt">' + esc(g.text || '') + '</div>' +
        '<div class="off-log-meta">' + esc(g.by || '—') + ' · ' + esc(g.at || '') + '</div></div>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  function typeTag(t){
    if (t === 'منتظم')   return '<span class="off-tag t-emp">منتظم</span>';
    if (t === 'مقاول')   return '<span class="off-tag t-con">مقاول</span>';
    if (t === 'استشاري') return '<span class="off-tag t-adv">استشاري</span>';
    return '<span class="off-tag t-none">—</span>';
  }

  function renderTable(){
    var body = document.getElementById('offBody');
    if (!body) return;
    var cnt = document.getElementById('offFilterCount');
    if (cnt) cnt.textContent = 'عرض ' + filtered.length + ' من ' + rows.length + ' موظف';

    if (!filtered.length){
      body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="13"><div class="veh-empty">' +
        '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M3 21h18"/><path d="M5 21V6a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h6a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v15"/><path d="M13 21V10h5a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v10"/></svg>' +
        '<div>' + (rows.length ? 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة للتصفية الحالية.' : 'لا توجد سجلات بعد — اضغط «إضافة موظف» للبدء.') + '</div>' +
        '</div></td></tr>';
      var pi0 = document.getElementById('offPageInfo');
      if (pi0) pi0.textContent = '—';
      var pg0 = document.getElementById('offPager');
      if (pg0) pg0.innerHTML = '';
      return;
    }

    var start = (page-1) * PAGE_SIZE;
    var slice = filtered.slice(start, start + PAGE_SIZE);
    var pi = document.getElementById('offPageInfo');
    if (pi) pi.textContent = 'الصفحة ' + page + ' من ' + Math.ceil(filtered.length/PAGE_SIZE) +
      ' — السجلات ' + (start+1) + ' إلى ' + Math.min(start+PAGE_SIZE, filtered.length) +
      ' من ' + filtered.length;
    renderPager();

    body.innerHTML = slice.map(function(r){
      var editable = canEdit(r);
      var hasPending = reqs.some(function(q){ return q.status === 'pending' && q.rowId === r._id; });
      return '<tr>' +
        '<td style="font-weight:600;">' + esc(r.name) + (hasPending ? ' <span class="veh-badge st-soon">طلب نقل معلّق</span>' : '') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + esc(r.empNo || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:center;">' + typeTag(r.etype) + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.dept || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="task-cell">' + esc(r.division || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.building || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.officeType || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + esc(r.officeNo || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + esc(r.ext || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + esc(r.phone || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.city || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.consultant || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:center;"><div class="veh-row-actions">' +
          '<button type="button" class="veh-icon-btn move" data-move="' + esc(r._id) + '" title="طلب نقل بين المكاتب">' +
            '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 12h16M14 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg>' +
          '</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="veh-icon-btn" data-edit="' + esc(r._id) + '" title="' + (editable ? 'تعديل' : 'تعديل — يتطلب صلاحية') + '"' + (editable ? '' : ' style="opacity:.5"') + '>' +
            '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4Z"/></svg>' +
          '</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="veh-icon-btn danger" data-del="' + esc(r._id) + '" title="' + (editable ? 'حذف' : 'حذف — يتطلب صلاحية') + '"' + (editable ? '' : ' style="opacity:.5"') + '>' +
            '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 7h16M9 7V5a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h4a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v2M6 7l1 13a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h8a1 1 0 0 0 1-1l1-13"/></svg>' +
          '</button>' +
        '</div></td>' +
      '</tr>';
    }).join('');
  }

  /* أرقام الصفحات: ١ ٢ ٣ … مع السابق والتالي واختيار عدد السجلات */
  function pageNumbers(cur, total){
    var out = [], i;
    if (total <= 9){
      for (i=1;i<=total;i++) out.push(i);
      return out;
    }
    out.push(1);
    var from = Math.max(2, cur-2), to = Math.min(total-1, cur+2);
    if (from > 2) out.push('…');
    for (i=from;i<=to;i++) out.push(i);
    if (to < total-1) out.push('…');
    out.push(total);
    return out;
  }

  function renderPager(){
    var host = document.getElementById('offPager');
    if (!host) return;
    var total = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE));
    var html = '';
    html += '<button type="button" class="off-page-btn" data-page="prev"' + (page <= 1 ? ' disabled' : '') + '>‹ السابق</button>';
    pageNumbers(page, total).forEach(function(n){
      if (n === '…'){ html += '<span class="off-page-gap">…</span>'; return; }
      html += '<button type="button" class="off-page-btn' + (n === page ? ' is-current' : '') +
              '" data-page="' + n + '"' + (n === page ? ' disabled' : '') + '>' + n + '</button>';
    });
    html += '<button type="button" class="off-page-btn" data-page="next"' + (page >= total ? ' disabled' : '') + '>التالي ›</button>';
    html += '<select class="off-page-size" id="offPageSize" title="عدد السجلات في الصفحة">' +
            [25,50,100,200].map(function(v){
              return '<option value="' + v + '"' + (v === PAGE_SIZE ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + v + ' / صفحة</option>';
            }).join('') + '</select>';
    host.innerHTML = html;
  }

  function goPage(n){
    var total = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(filtered.length / PAGE_SIZE));
    if (n === 'prev') n = page - 1;
    else if (n === 'next') n = page + 1;
    else n = parseInt(n, 10);
    if (!n || n < 1) n = 1;
    if (n > total) n = total;
    if (n === page) return;
    page = n;
    renderTable();
    var sec = document.getElementById('offSecTable');
    if (sec) sec.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
  }

  function renderFilters(){
    function fill(id, values, keep){
      var sel = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!sel) return;
      var cur = sel.value;
      var first = sel.options[0] ? sel.options[0].outerHTML : '';
      sel.innerHTML = first + values.map(function(v){
        return '<option value="' + esc(v) + '">' + esc(v) + '</option>';
      }).join('');
      if (keep && values.indexOf(cur) !== -1) sel.value = cur;
    }
    fill('offFBuilding',   buildingList(), true);
    fill('offFDept',       uniq(rows.map(function(r){ return r.dept; })), true);
    fill('offFDivision',   uniq(rows.map(function(r){ return r.division; })), true);
    fill('offFType',       uniq(rows.map(function(r){ return r.etype; })), true);
    fill('offFOfficeType', uniq(rows.map(function(r){ return r.officeType; })), true);
  }

  function renderAll(){
    renderFilters();
    applyFilters();
    renderKPIs();
    renderDist();
    renderReqs();
    renderLog();
    renderTable();
    renderBell();
    refreshSessionUI();
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ٨ · السجل والتغييرات
     ====================================================================== */
  function pushLog(kind, text){
    var g = {_id: uid('g'), kind: kind, text: text, by: (me() || 'زائر') + (admin() ? ' (مشرف)' : ''), at: nowStamp()};
    logs.unshift(g);
    saveLogs();
    syncLog(g._id, me() || '', g);
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ٩ · نموذج الإضافة والتعديل
     ====================================================================== */
  function fillSelect(id, values, selected){
    var sel = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!sel) return;
    sel.innerHTML = values.map(function(v){
      var lbl = v === '' ? '— غير محدد —' : v;
      return '<option value="' + esc(v) + '"' + (v === selected ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + esc(lbl) + '</option>';
    }).join('');
  }
  function fillDatalist(id, values){
    var dl = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!dl) return;
    dl.innerHTML = values.map(function(v){ return '<option value="' + esc(v) + '">'; }).join('');
  }

  function openModal(row){
    editingId = row ? row._id : null;
    var t = document.getElementById('offModalTitle');
    if (t) t.textContent = row ? 'تعديل بيانات الموظف' : 'إضافة موظف';

    var mine = me();
    fillSelect('offInDept', deptList(), row ? row.dept : (mine || deptList()[0]));
    fillSelect('offInBuilding', buildingList(), row ? row.building : buildingList()[0]);
    fillSelect('offInOfficeType', officeTypeList(), row ? row.officeType : '');
    fillDatalist('offSectorList', uniq(rows.map(function(r){ return r.sector; })));
    fillDatalist('offDivisionList', uniq(rows.map(function(r){ return r.division; })));
    fillDatalist('offConsultantList', uniq(rows.map(function(r){ return r.consultant; })));

    var set = function(id, v){ var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.value = v || ''; };
    set('offInName',       row && row.name);
    set('offInEmpNo',      row && row.empNo);
    set('offInSector',     row && row.sector);
    set('offInDivision',   row && row.division);
    set('offInOfficeNo',   row && row.officeNo);
    set('offInExt',        row && row.ext);
    set('offInPhone',      row && row.phone);
    set('offInCity',       row && row.city);
    set('offInConsultant', row && row.consultant);
    set('offInNotes',      row && row.notes);
    var ty = document.getElementById('offInType');
    if (ty) ty.value = (row && row.etype) ? row.etype : 'منتظم';

    var ov = document.getElementById('offModalOverlay');
    if (ov) ov.classList.add('open');
    var f = document.getElementById('offInName');
    if (f) setTimeout(function(){ f.focus(); }, 60);
  }
  function closeModal(){
    var ov = document.getElementById('offModalOverlay');
    if (ov) ov.classList.remove('open');
    editingId = null;
  }

  function createRequest(row, next, reason){
    var q = {
      _id: uid('q'),
      rowId: row._id,
      name: row.name,
      empNo: row.empNo,
      fromBuilding: row.building,   toBuilding: next.building,
      fromOfficeType: row.officeType, toOfficeType: next.officeType,
      fromOfficeNo: row.officeNo,   toOfficeNo: next.officeNo,
      fromDept: row.dept,           toDept: next.dept,
      reason: reason || '',
      by: me() || 'غير معروف',
      at: nowStamp(),
      status: 'pending'
    };
    reqs.unshift(q);
    saveReqs();
    syncReq(q._id, q.by, q);
    pushLog('request', 'طلب تغيير مكتب/إدارة للموظف «' + (row.name||'') + '» — بانتظار الاعتماد');
    return q;
  }

  function officeChanged(row, next){
    return (row.building   || '') !== (next.building   || '') ||
           (row.officeType || '') !== (next.officeType || '') ||
           (row.officeNo   || '') !== (next.officeNo   || '') ||
           (row.dept       || '') !== (next.dept       || '');
  }

  function submitForm(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!authed()){ guard(function(){}); return; }

    var rec = {
      name:       val('offInName'),
      empNo:      val('offInEmpNo'),
      etype:      val('offInType'),
      sector:     val('offInSector'),
      dept:       val('offInDept'),
      division:   val('offInDivision'),
      building:   val('offInBuilding'),
      officeType: val('offInOfficeType'),
      officeNo:   val('offInOfficeNo'),
      ext:        val('offInExt'),
      phone:      val('offInPhone'),
      city:       val('offInCity'),
      consultant: val('offInConsultant'),
      notes:      val('offInNotes')
    };

    if (editingId){
      var idx = -1;
      for (var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){ if (rows[i]._id === editingId){ idx = i; break; } }
      if (idx === -1){ closeModal(); return; }
      var cur = rows[idx];
      if (!canEdit(cur)){ toast('غير مصرح لك بتعديل هذا السجل'); return; }

      if (!admin() && officeChanged(cur, rec)){
        /* التعديلات العامة تُطبَّق، وتغيير المكتب/الإدارة يذهب للاعتماد */
        var next = {building: rec.building, officeType: rec.officeType, officeNo: rec.officeNo, dept: rec.dept};
        createRequest(cur, next, 'تعديل من صفحة بيانات الموظف');
        rec.building   = cur.building;
        rec.officeType = cur.officeType;
        rec.officeNo   = cur.officeNo;
        rec.dept       = cur.dept;
        rec._id = editingId;
        rows[idx] = rec;
        saveRows();
        syncRow(rec._id, rec.dept, rec);
        pushLog('edit', 'تحديث بيانات «' + rec.name + '» (البيانات العامة)');
        toast('تم حفظ البيانات العامة، وأُرسل تغيير المكتب/الإدارة للاعتماد ✓');
        closeModal(); renderAll();
        return;
      }

      if (officeChanged(cur, rec)){
        pushLog('approve', 'تغيير مباشر للمكتب/الإدارة للموظف «' + rec.name + '»: ' +
          (cur.building||'—') + '/' + (cur.officeNo||'—') + ' ← ' + (rec.building||'—') + '/' + (rec.officeNo||'—'));
      } else {
        pushLog('edit', 'تحديث بيانات «' + rec.name + '»');
      }
      rec._id = editingId;
      rows[idx] = rec;
      toast('تم تحديث بيانات الموظف ✓');
    } else {
      if (!admin() && me() && rec.dept !== me()){
        toast('غير مصرح لك بإضافة سجل يخص إدارة أخرى');
        return;
      }
      rec._id = uid();
      rows.push(rec);
      pushLog('add', 'إضافة موظف «' + rec.name + '» إلى ' + (rec.building||'—'));
      toast('تمت إضافة الموظف ✓');
    }
    saveRows();
    syncRow(rec._id, rec.dept, rec);
    closeModal();
    renderAll();
  }

  function removeRow(id){
    var idx = -1;
    for (var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){ if (rows[i]._id === id){ idx = i; break; } }
    if (idx === -1) return;
    var r = rows[idx];
    if (!canEdit(r)){ toast('غير مصرح لك بحذف هذا السجل'); return; }
    if (!confirm('هل تريد حذف سجل «' + (r.name || '') + '»؟\nلا يمكن التراجع عن هذا الإجراء.')) return;
    rows.splice(idx, 1);
    saveRows();
    syncRow(id, r.dept, null);
    pushLog('delete', 'حذف سجل الموظف «' + (r.name||'') + '»');
    toast('تم حذف السجل');
    renderAll();
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ١٠ · نافذة النقل بين المكاتب
     ====================================================================== */
  function openMove(row){
    movingId = row._id;
    var cur = document.getElementById('offMoveCurrent');
    if (cur){
      cur.innerHTML =
        '<div><b>' + esc(row.name || '—') + '</b> — الرقم الوظيفي ' + esc(row.empNo || '—') + '</div>' +
        '<div>الوضع الحالي: المبنى <b>' + esc(row.building || '—') + '</b> · نوع المكتب <b>' + esc(row.officeType || '—') + '</b> · رقم المكتب <b>' + esc(row.officeNo || '—') + '</b></div>' +
        '<div>الإدارة الحالية: <b>' + esc(row.dept || '—') + '</b> · الدائرة ' + esc(row.division || '—') + '</div>';
    }
    fillSelect('offMvBuilding', buildingList(), row.building);
    fillSelect('offMvOfficeType', officeTypeList(), row.officeType);
    fillSelect('offMvDept', deptList(), row.dept);
    var no = document.getElementById('offMvOfficeNo');
    if (no) no.value = row.officeNo || '';
    var rs = document.getElementById('offMvReason');
    if (rs) rs.value = '';

    var noteT = document.getElementById('offMoveNoteText');
    var subm  = document.getElementById('offMoveSubmit');
    if (admin()){
      if (noteT) noteT.textContent = 'أنت مشرف: سيُطبَّق النقل مباشرة ويُسجَّل في سجل التغييرات.';
      if (subm) subm.textContent = 'تطبيق النقل';
    } else {
      if (noteT) noteT.textContent = 'سيُرسل الطلب إلى المشرف للاعتماد قبل تطبيقه على السجل.';
      if (subm) subm.textContent = 'إرسال الطلب';
    }
    var ov = document.getElementById('offMoveOverlay');
    if (ov) ov.classList.add('open');
  }
  function closeMove(){
    var ov = document.getElementById('offMoveOverlay');
    if (ov) ov.classList.remove('open');
    movingId = null;
  }

  function submitMove(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!authed()){ guard(function(){}); return; }
    var row = rows.filter(function(x){ return x._id === movingId; })[0];
    if (!row){ closeMove(); return; }

    var next = {
      building:   val('offMvBuilding'),
      officeType: val('offMvOfficeType'),
      officeNo:   val('offMvOfficeNo'),
      dept:       val('offMvDept')
    };
    var reason = val('offMvReason');

    if (!officeChanged(row, next)){
      toast('لم يتغيّر شيء — عدّل المبنى أو رقم المكتب أو الإدارة');
      return;
    }
    if (!admin() && me() && row.dept !== me() && next.dept !== me()){
      toast('تستطيع طلب نقل موظفي إدارتك فقط');
      return;
    }

    if (admin()){
      var before = row.building + '/' + (row.officeNo||'—') + ' · ' + row.dept;
      row.building = next.building; row.officeType = next.officeType;
      row.officeNo = next.officeNo; row.dept = next.dept;
      saveRows();
      syncRow(row._id, row.dept, row);
      pushLog('approve', 'نقل مباشر للموظف «' + row.name + '»: ' + before + ' ← ' +
        next.building + '/' + (next.officeNo||'—') + ' · ' + next.dept + (reason ? ' — ' + reason : ''));
      toast('تم تطبيق النقل ✓');
    } else {
      createRequest(row, next, reason);
      toast('تم إرسال طلب النقل للاعتماد ✓');
    }
    closeMove();
    renderAll();
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ١١ · الاعتماد والرفض
     ====================================================================== */
  function decide(id, ok){
    if (!admin()){ toast('الاعتماد متاح للمشرف فقط'); return; }
    var q = reqs.filter(function(x){ return x._id === id; })[0];
    if (!q || q.status !== 'pending') return;
    var note = '';
    if (!ok){
      note = prompt('سبب الرفض (اختياري):') || '';
    }
    q.status = ok ? 'approved' : 'rejected';
    q.decidedBy = me() || 'مشرف';
    q.decidedAt = nowStamp();
    q.decisionNote = note;

    if (ok){
      var row = rows.filter(function(x){ return x._id === q.rowId; })[0];
      if (row){
        row.building   = q.toBuilding;
        row.officeType = q.toOfficeType;
        row.officeNo   = q.toOfficeNo;
        row.dept       = q.toDept;
        saveRows();
        syncRow(row._id, row.dept, row);
      }
      pushLog('approve', 'اعتماد نقل «' + (q.name||'') + '»: ' +
        (q.fromBuilding||'—') + '/' + (q.fromOfficeNo||'—') + ' · ' + (q.fromDept||'—') + ' ← ' +
        (q.toBuilding||'—') + '/' + (q.toOfficeNo||'—') + ' · ' + (q.toDept||'—') +
        ' (طلب من ' + (q.by||'—') + ')');
      toast('تم اعتماد الطلب وتطبيقه ✓');
    } else {
      pushLog('reject', 'رفض طلب نقل «' + (q.name||'') + '» المقدَّم من ' + (q.by||'—') + (note ? ' — ' + note : ''));
      toast('تم رفض الطلب');
    }
    saveReqs();
    syncReq(q._id, q.by, q);
    markSeen();
    renderAll();
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ١٢ · التصدير والطباعة
     ====================================================================== */
  function csvBlob(lines, fname){
    var blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF' + lines.join('\r\n')], {type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'});
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = fname;
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
    setTimeout(function(){ URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); a.remove(); }, 400);
  }
  function q(v){ return '"' + String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/"/g,'""') + '"'; }

  function exportCSV(){
    var head = ['الاسم','الرقم الوظيفي','الفئة','النشاط/القطاع','الإدارة','الدائرة','المبنى',
                'نوع المكتب','رقم المكتب','التحويلة','رقم الجوال','المدينة - الحي','مكتب الاستشاري','ملاحظات'];
    var lines = [head.map(q).join(',')];
    filtered.forEach(function(r){
      lines.push([r.name,r.empNo,r.etype,r.sector,r.dept,r.division,r.building,
                  r.officeType,r.officeNo,r.ext,r.phone,r.city,r.consultant,r.notes].map(q).join(','));
    });
    csvBlob(lines, 'بيانات-المكاتب-' + nowStamp().slice(0,10) + '.csv');
    toast('تم تحميل ' + filtered.length + ' سجلًا ✓');
  }
  function exportLogCSV(){
    var head = ['النوع','التفاصيل','المستخدم','التاريخ'];
    var lines = [head.map(q).join(',')];
    logs.forEach(function(g){ lines.push([g.kind,g.text,g.by,g.at].map(q).join(',')); });
    csvBlob(lines, 'سجل-تغييرات-المكاتب-' + nowStamp().slice(0,10) + '.csv');
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ١٣ · الربط
     ====================================================================== */
  function bind(){
    var logo = document.getElementById('offLogo');
    var src  = document.querySelector('#heroBanner .brand-mark img');
    if (logo && src && src.getAttribute('src')) logo.src = src.getAttribute('src');

    var back = document.getElementById('offBackHome');
    if (back) back.addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (typeof window.SE_GO_HOME === 'function') window.SE_GO_HOME();
      else { location.hash = '#home'; location.reload(); }
    });

    var themeBtn = document.getElementById('offTheme');
    function syncThemeIcons(){
      var dark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
      var sun  = document.querySelector('#offTheme .theme-icon-sun');
      var moon = document.querySelector('#offTheme .theme-icon-moon');
      if (sun)  sun.style.display  = dark ? 'none' : '';
      if (moon) moon.style.display = dark ? '' : 'none';
    }
    if (themeBtn) themeBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var cur = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', cur);
      try{ localStorage.setItem('fk_sec_dashboard_theme_v1', cur); }catch(e){}
      syncThemeIcons();
    });
    syncThemeIcons();

    var pill = document.getElementById('offSessionPill');
    if (pill) pill.addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (authed()){
        if (!confirm('هل تريد تسجيل الخروج؟')) return;
        try{ if (typeof setCurrentUser === 'function') setCurrentUser(null); }catch(e){}
        try{ if (typeof setAuthToken === 'function') setAuthToken(null); }catch(e){}
        renderAll();
        toast('تم تسجيل الخروج');
      } else if (typeof openLoginModal === 'function'){
        openLoginModal();
      }
    });

    var bell = document.getElementById('offBell');
    if (bell) bell.addEventListener('click', function(){
      askNotifyPermission();
      markSeen();
      var sec = document.getElementById('offSecReq');
      if (sec) sec.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
    });

    var addBtn = document.getElementById('offBtnAdd');
    if (addBtn) addBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ guard(function(){ renderAll(); openModal(null); }); });

    var cancel = document.getElementById('offBtnCancel');
    if (cancel) cancel.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    var close = document.getElementById('offModalClose');
    if (close) close.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    var ov = document.getElementById('offModalOverlay');
    if (ov) ov.addEventListener('click', function(e){ if (e.target === ov) closeModal(); });

    var mCancel = document.getElementById('offMoveCancel');
    if (mCancel) mCancel.addEventListener('click', closeMove);
    var mClose = document.getElementById('offMoveClose');
    if (mClose) mClose.addEventListener('click', closeMove);
    var mOv = document.getElementById('offMoveOverlay');
    if (mOv) mOv.addEventListener('click', function(e){ if (e.target === mOv) closeMove(); });

    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if (e.key !== 'Escape') return;
      if (ov && ov.classList.contains('open')) closeModal();
      if (mOv && mOv.classList.contains('open')) closeMove();
    });

    var form = document.getElementById('offForm');
    if (form) form.addEventListener('submit', submitForm);
    var mForm = document.getElementById('offMoveForm');
    if (mForm) mForm.addEventListener('submit', submitMove);

    var body = document.getElementById('offBody');
    if (body) body.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var mv = e.target.closest('[data-move]');
      if (mv){
        var mid = mv.getAttribute('data-move');
        guard(function(){
          var r = rows.filter(function(x){ return x._id === mid; })[0];
          if (r) openMove(r);
        });
        return;
      }
      var ed = e.target.closest('[data-edit]');
      if (ed){
        var id = ed.getAttribute('data-edit');
        guard(function(){
          var r = rows.filter(function(x){ return x._id === id; })[0];
          if (!r) return;
          if (!canEdit(r)){ toast('غير مصرح لك بتعديل سجل إدارة أخرى'); return; }
          openModal(r);
        });
        return;
      }
      var dl = e.target.closest('[data-del]');
      if (dl){
        var did = dl.getAttribute('data-del');
        guard(function(){ removeRow(did); });
      }
    });

    var reqHost = document.getElementById('offReqList');
    if (reqHost) reqHost.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var ok = e.target.closest('[data-ok]');
      if (ok){ guard(function(){ decide(ok.getAttribute('data-ok'), true); }); return; }
      var no = e.target.closest('[data-no]');
      if (no){ guard(function(){ decide(no.getAttribute('data-no'), false); }); }
    });

    var tabP = document.getElementById('offReqTabPending');
    var tabA = document.getElementById('offReqTabAll');
    function setTab(v){
      reqView = v;
      if (tabP){
        tabP.style.background = v === 'pending' ? 'var(--blue-2)' : '';
        tabP.style.color = v === 'pending' ? '#fff' : '';
        tabP.style.borderColor = v === 'pending' ? 'var(--blue-2)' : '';
      }
      if (tabA){
        tabA.style.background = v === 'all' ? 'var(--blue-2)' : '';
        tabA.style.color = v === 'all' ? '#fff' : '';
        tabA.style.borderColor = v === 'all' ? 'var(--blue-2)' : '';
      }
      renderReqs();
    }
    if (tabP) tabP.addEventListener('click', function(){ setTab('pending'); });
    if (tabA) tabA.addEventListener('click', function(){ setTab('all'); });

    var FILTERS = ['offFSearch','offFBuilding','offFDept','offFDivision','offFType','offFOfficeType','offFHas'];
    FILTERS.forEach(function(id){
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!el) return;
      el.addEventListener(el.tagName === 'INPUT' ? 'input' : 'change', function(){
        page = 1; applyFilters(); renderTable();
      });
    });
    var reset = document.getElementById('offFReset');
    if (reset) reset.addEventListener('click', function(){
      FILTERS.forEach(function(id){ var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.value = ''; });
      page = 1; applyFilters(); renderTable();
    });

    var pager = document.getElementById('offPager');
    if (pager){
      pager.addEventListener('click', function(e){
        var b = e.target.closest('[data-page]');
        if (b && !b.disabled) goPage(b.getAttribute('data-page'));
      });
      pager.addEventListener('change', function(e){
        if (e.target && e.target.id === 'offPageSize'){
          PAGE_SIZE = parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 50;
          page = 1;
          applyFilters(); renderTable();
        }
      });
    }

    var ths = document.querySelectorAll('#offTable th.sortable');
    [].forEach.call(ths, function(th){
      th.addEventListener('click', function(){
        var k = th.getAttribute('data-sort');
        if (sortKey === k) sortDir = (sortDir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        else { sortKey = k; sortDir = 'asc'; }
        [].forEach.call(ths, function(x){ x.classList.remove('active','dir-asc','dir-desc'); });
        th.classList.add('active', sortDir === 'asc' ? 'dir-asc' : 'dir-desc');
        page = 1; applyFilters(); renderTable();
      });
    });

    var dl2 = document.getElementById('offBtnDownload');
    if (dl2) dl2.addEventListener('click', exportCSV);
    var lg = document.getElementById('offBtnLogCsv');
    if (lg) lg.addEventListener('click', exportLogCSV);
    var pr = document.getElementById('offBtnPrint');
    if (pr) pr.addEventListener('click', function(){ window.print(); });

    var nav = document.getElementById('offNav');
    if (nav){
      var items = [].slice.call(nav.querySelectorAll('.section-nav-item'));
      var spy = function(){
        nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 40);
        var best = null, bestD = 1e9;
        items.forEach(function(a){
          var sec = document.getElementById(a.getAttribute('data-target'));
          if (!sec) return;
          var d = Math.abs(sec.getBoundingClientRect().top - 120);
          if (d < bestD){ bestD = d; best = a; }
        });
        items.forEach(function(a){ a.classList.toggle('active', a === best); });
      };
      window.addEventListener('scroll', spy, {passive:true});
      spy();
    }

    /* مزامنة بين التبويبات المفتوحة */
    window.addEventListener('storage', function(e){
      if (!e.key) return;
      if (e.key === LS_ROWS) rows = readJSON(LS_ROWS, rows);
      else if (e.key === LS_REQS){ reqs = readJSON(LS_REQS, reqs); notifyNew(); }
      else if (e.key === LS_LOG) logs = readJSON(LS_LOG, logs);
      else return;
      renderAll();
    });

    var lastAuth = authed() + '|' + (me() || '') + '|' + admin();
    setInterval(function(){
      var now = authed() + '|' + (me() || '') + '|' + admin();
      if (now !== lastAuth){ lastAuth = now; if (admin()) askNotifyPermission(); renderAll(); notifyNew(); }
    }, 800);
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ١٤ · تنظيف صندوق الاعتماد وسجل التغييرات
     ====================================================================== */
  function isDemo(x){ return !!(x && x.demo); }

  function stampAgo(days, hh, mm){
    var d = new Date();
    d.setDate(d.getDate() - days);
    d.setHours(hh, mm, 0, 0);
    var p = function(n){ return n<10 ? '0'+n : ''+n; };
    return d.getFullYear()+'-'+p(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+p(d.getDate())+' '+p(d.getHours())+':'+p(d.getMinutes());
  }

  /* تنظيف لمرة واحدة لصندوق الاعتماد وسجل التغييرات */
  function seedDemo(){
    var before = reqs.length + logs.length;
    reqs = reqs.filter(function(x){ return !isDemo(x); });
    logs = logs.filter(function(x){ return !isDemo(x); });
    if (reqs.length + logs.length !== before){ saveReqs(); saveLogs(); }
    try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_DEMO, 'disabled'); }catch(e){}
  }

  function boot(){
    rows = loadRows();
    reqs = readJSON(LS_REQS, []);
    logs = readJSON(LS_LOG, []);
    seedDemo();
    bind();
    var th0 = document.querySelector('#offTable th[data-sort="building"]');
    if (th0) th0.classList.add('active','dir-asc');
    renderAll();
    notifyNew();
    pullState();
    setInterval(pullState, 60000);
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>

  mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000 0%,#000 52%,rgba(0,0,0,0) 100%);

<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/three.js/r128/three.min.js"></script>
<script>
function seBuildGrid(cvId, bandId, opts){
  var cv = document.getElementById(cvId);
  if(!cv || !window.THREE) return;
  var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  var band = document.getElementById(bandId);
  opts = opts || {};

  var NAVY = 0x04182F, WIRE = 0x2E86E0, TOWER = 0x5FB8FF;
  var SPACING = 26, ROWS = [-11, 11], COUNT = 9, ARM = [9.6, 12.2];

  var scene = new THREE.Scene();
  scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(NAVY, 40, 200);
  var camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(52, 1, 0.1, 400);
  camera.position.set(0, 7.5, 26);

  var renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({canvas:cv, antialias:true, alpha:true});
  renderer.setClearColor(0x000000, 0);

  function pylonPts(){
    var p = [], hb = 1.7, ht = 0.55, H = 14;
    var base = [[-hb,-hb],[hb,-hb],[hb,hb],[-hb,hb]];
    var top  = [[-ht,-ht],[ht,-ht],[ht,ht],[-ht,ht]];
    for(var i=0;i<4;i++){
      p.push(base[i][0],0,base[i][1], top[i][0],H,top[i][1]);
    }
    [3.2,6.4,9.6,12.4].forEach(function(y){
      var t = y/H;
      for(var i=0;i<4;i++){
        var j=(i+1)%4;
        var a=[base[i][0]+(top[i][0]-base[i][0])*t, base[i][1]+(top[i][1]-base[i][1])*t];
        var b=[base[j][0]+(top[j][0]-base[j][0])*t, base[j][1]+(top[j][1]-base[j][1])*t];
        p.push(a[0],y,a[1], b[0],y,b[1]);
      }
    });
    for(var k=0;k<3;k++){
      var y0=[0,3.2,6.4][k], y1=[3.2,6.4,9.6][k];
      var t0=y0/H, t1=y1/H;
      for(var f=0;f<4;f++){
        var g=(f+1)%4;
        var a0=[base[f][0]+(top[f][0]-base[f][0])*t0, base[f][1]+(top[f][1]-base[f][1])*t0];
        var b1=[base[g][0]+(top[g][0]-base[g][0])*t1, base[g][1]+(top[g][1]-base[g][1])*t1];
        p.push(a0[0],y0,a0[1], b1[0],y1,b1[1]);
      }
    }
    ARM.forEach(function(y,idx){
      var w = idx===0 ? 6.2 : 4.2;
      p.push(-w,y,0, w,y,0);
      p.push(-w,y,0, 0,y+1.5,0, w,y,0, 0,y+1.5,0);
    });
    return p;
  }

  var towerGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  towerGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(pylonPts(), 3));
  var towerMat = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:TOWER, transparent:true, opacity:0.62});
  var wireMat  = new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:WIRE,  transparent:true, opacity:0.40});

  var group = new THREE.Group();
  scene.add(group);

  function catenary(x, y, z0, z1, sag){
    var pts=[], N=16;
    for(var i=0;i<=N;i++){
      var t=i/N;
      var z=z0+(z1-z0)*t;
      var d=y - sag*(1-Math.pow(2*t-1,2));
      pts.push(new THREE.Vector3(x, d, z));
    }
    return pts;
  }

  ROWS.forEach(function(rx){
    for(var i=0;i<COUNT;i++){
      var z = -i*SPACING;
      var t = new THREE.LineSegments(towerGeo, towerMat);
      t.position.set(rx, 0, z);
      group.add(t);
      if(i<COUNT-1){
        [[6.2,ARM[0]],[-6.2,ARM[0]],[4.2,ARM[1]],[-4.2,ARM[1]]].forEach(function(a){
          var g = new THREE.BufferGeometry().setFromPoints(catenary(rx+a[0], a[1], z, z-SPACING, 2.4));
          group.add(new THREE.Line(g, wireMat));
        });
      }
    }
  });

  var groundGeo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  var gp=[], W=90, D=COUNT*SPACING;
  for(var x=-W;x<=W;x+=15){ gp.push(x,0,-D, x,0,SPACING); }
  for(var z=-D;z<=SPACING;z+=15){ gp.push(-W,0,z, W,0,z); }
  groundGeo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(gp,3));
  group.add(new THREE.LineSegments(groundGeo, new THREE.LineBasicMaterial({color:0x14507F, transparent:true, opacity:0.30})));

  function resize(){
    var w = band.clientWidth, h = band.clientHeight;
    if(!w || !h) return;
    renderer.setPixelRatio(Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1, 1.75));
    renderer.setSize(w, h, false);
    camera.aspect = w/h; camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  }
  resize();
  window.addEventListener('resize', resize);


  var lastW = cv.clientWidth, lastH = cv.clientHeight;
  var start = performance.now();
  function frame(now){
    requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    if(document.hidden) return;
    if(band.offsetParent === null) return;
    if(opts.homeOnly && !document.documentElement.classList.contains('se-home')) return;
    if(opts.notHome && document.documentElement.classList.contains('se-home')) return;
    if(cv.clientWidth !== lastW || cv.clientHeight !== lastH){
      resize(); lastW = cv.clientWidth; lastH = cv.clientHeight;
    }
    var el = (now-start)/1000;
    group.position.z = reduce ? 0 : (el*1.5) % SPACING;
    camera.position.x = 0;
    camera.position.y = 7.5;
    camera.lookAt(0, 8.5, -60);
    renderer.render(scene, camera);
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
seBuildGrid('seGrid3d','seGridBand',{homeOnly:true});
seBuildGrid('seHeroGrid','seHeroBand',{notHome:true});
</script>
