<script id="se-vehicles-engine">
(function(){
  if (!document.documentElement.classList.contains('se-view-vehicles')) return;

  /* ======================================================================
     ١ · بيانات السجل
     ====================================================================== */
  /* السجل يبدأ فارغًا */
  var VEH_SEED = [];
  var VEH_CLASSES = ['سيدان','دفع رباعي','وانيت','فان / باص','شاحنة','مركبة متخصصة'];
  var VEH_PROVIDERS = ['إدارة الخدمات العامة','إدارة النقل والإسناد اللوجستي','إدارة عقود اوامر الشراء'];

  var LS_ROWS   = 'fk_se_vehicles_rows_v1';
  var LS_SEEDED = 'fk_se_vehicles_seeded_v1';

  var rows = [], filtered = [];
  var sortKey = 'end', sortDir = 'asc';
  var editingId = null;

  function uid(p){ return (p||'v') + Date.now().toString(36) + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7); }
  function esc(s){
    return String(s == null ? '' : s)
      .replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;')
      .replace(/"/g,'&quot;').replace(/'/g,'&#39;');
  }
  function toast(msg){ if (typeof showToast === 'function'){ showToast(msg); return; } try{ console.log(msg); }catch(e){} }
  function writeJSON(key, val){ try{ localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(val)); }catch(e){} }
  function readJSON(key, fallback){
    try{ var raw = localStorage.getItem(key); if (!raw) return fallback; var v = JSON.parse(raw); return v || fallback; }catch(e){ return fallback; }
  }
  function uniq(list){
    var out = [];
    list.forEach(function(v){ if (v && out.indexOf(v) === -1) out.push(v); });
    return out.sort(function(a,b){ return String(a).localeCompare(String(b),'ar'); });
  }

  /* تنظيف لمرة واحدة للمخزن المحلي */
  var LS_PURGED = 'fk_se_vehicles_demo_purged_v1';
  (function purgeOldDemo(){
    try{
      if (localStorage.getItem(LS_PURGED) === '1') return;
      localStorage.removeItem(LS_ROWS);
      localStorage.removeItem(LS_SEEDED);
      localStorage.setItem(LS_PURGED, '1');
    }catch(e){}
  })();

  function loadRows(){
    var raw = null;
    try{ raw = localStorage.getItem(LS_ROWS); }catch(e){}
    if (raw){ try{ return JSON.parse(raw) || []; }catch(e){ return []; } }
    var seeded = false;
    try{ seeded = localStorage.getItem(LS_SEEDED) === '1'; }catch(e){}
    if (seeded) return [];
    var out = VEH_SEED.map(function(r){ var o = {}; for (var k in r) o[k] = r[k]; o._id = uid(); return o; });
    try{ localStorage.setItem(LS_SEEDED,'1'); }catch(e){}
    writeJSON(LS_ROWS, out);
    return out;
  }
  function saveRows(){ writeJSON(LS_ROWS, rows); }

  /* ======================================================================
     ٢ · الصلاحيات (تُستخدم نفس دوال صفحة المكاتب/الدخول العامة)
     ====================================================================== */
  function me(){ try{ return (typeof getCurrentUser === 'function') ? getCurrentUser() : null; }catch(e){ return null; } }
  function authed(){ try{ return (typeof isAuthed === 'function') ? isAuthed() : false; }catch(e){ return false; } }
  function admin(){ try{ return (typeof getIsAdminFlag === 'function') ? getIsAdminFlag() : false; }catch(e){ return false; } }
  function canEdit(r){
    if (!authed()) return false;
    if (admin()) return true;
    var u = me();
    return !!u && (r.dept === u || r.providingDept === u);
  }
  function guard(fn){
    if (authed()){ fn(); return; }
    if (typeof requireAuth === 'function'){ requireAuth(fn); return; }
    if (typeof openLoginModal === 'function') openLoginModal();
  }
  function refreshSessionUI(){
    var label = document.getElementById('vehSessionLabel');
    var lock  = document.getElementById('vehAddLock');
    var note  = document.getElementById('vehPermNote');
    var noteT = document.getElementById('vehPermNoteText');
    var u = me();
    if (label){
      if (u && authed()){
        var lbl = u;
        try{
          if (typeof AUTHORIZED_USERS !== 'undefined'){
            var f = AUTHORIZED_USERS.filter(function(x){ return x.id === u; })[0];
            if (f) lbl = f.label;
          }
        }catch(e){}
        label.textContent = lbl + (admin() ? ' — مشرف' : '');
      } else {
        label.textContent = 'تسجيل الدخول';
      }
    }
    if (lock) lock.style.display = authed() ? 'none' : '';
    if (note && noteT){
      if (!authed()){
        noteT.textContent = 'أنت في وضع العرض فقط. سجّل الدخول لإضافة أو تعديل بيانات المركبات.';
        note.style.display = '';
      } else if (!admin()){
        noteT.textContent = 'تستطيع تعديل سجلات إدارتك فقط (' + me() + ').';
        note.style.display = '';
      } else {
        noteT.textContent = 'أنت مشرف: تعديلاتك على سجل المركبات تُطبَّق مباشرة.';
        note.style.display = '';
      }
    }
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ٣ · حالة العقد — تُشتق آليًا من تاريخ البداية والنهاية
     ====================================================================== */
  function todayStr(){
    var d = new Date(), p = function(n){ return n<10 ? '0'+n : ''+n; };
    return d.getFullYear()+'-'+p(d.getMonth()+1)+'-'+p(d.getDate());
  }
  function daysBetween(a, b){
    var da = new Date(a+'T00:00:00'), db = new Date(b+'T00:00:00');
    return Math.round((db - da) / 86400000);
  }
  function statusOf(r){
    var today = todayStr();
    if (!r.end) return 'active';
    if (r.start && r.start > today) return 'future';
    if (r.end < today) return 'expired';
    if (daysBetween(today, r.end) <= 90) return 'soon';
    return 'active';
  }
  function statusLabel(s){
    return {active:'ساري', soon:'يقارب الانتهاء', expired:'منتهي', future:'لم يبدأ بعد'}[s] || '—';
  }
  function statusBadge(s){
    var cls = {active:'st-active', soon:'st-soon', expired:'st-expired', future:'st-future'}[s] || 'st-active';
    return '<span class="veh-badge ' + cls + '">' + statusLabel(s) + '</span>';
  }
  function daysLeftLabel(r, s){
    if (!r.end) return '—';
    var d = daysBetween(todayStr(), r.end);
    if (s === 'expired') return 'منذ ' + Math.abs(d) + ' يوم';
    if (s === 'future')  return 'يبدأ بعد ' + Math.abs(daysBetween(todayStr(), r.start)) + ' يوم';
    return d + ' يوم';
  }
  function fmtDate(d){
    if (!d) return '—';
    var parts = d.split('-');
    return parts.length === 3 ? (parts[2] + '/' + parts[1] + '/' + parts[0]) : d;
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ٤ · التصفية والترتيب
     ====================================================================== */
  function val(id){ var el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value.trim() : ''; }

  function applyFilters(){
    var q   = val('vehFSearch').toLowerCase();
    var fD  = val('vehFDept');
    var fP  = val('vehFProv');
    var fC  = val('vehFClass');
    var fS  = val('vehFStatus');
    var fT  = val('vehFTerms');

    filtered = rows.filter(function(r){
      var st = statusOf(r);
      if (fD && r.dept !== fD) return false;
      if (fP && r.providingDept !== fP) return false;
      if (fC && r.vclass !== fC) return false;
      if (fS && st !== fS) return false;
      if (fT === 'yes' && !r.terms) return false;
      if (fT === 'no'  &&  r.terms) return false;
      if (q){
        var hay = [r.name, r.empNo, r.contractNo, r.project, r.dept, r.providingDept, r.make, r.model].join(' ').toLowerCase();
        if (hay.indexOf(q) === -1) return false;
      }
      return true;
    });

    filtered.sort(function(a,b){
      var av, bv;
      if (sortKey === 'status'){ av = statusOf(a); bv = statusOf(b); }
      else if (sortKey === 'daysLeft'){ av = a.end ? daysBetween(todayStr(), a.end) : 0; bv = b.end ? daysBetween(todayStr(), b.end) : 0; }
      else { av = a[sortKey] || ''; bv = b[sortKey] || ''; }
      var c;
      if (typeof av === 'number' && typeof bv === 'number') c = av - bv;
      else c = String(av).localeCompare(String(bv), 'ar');
      if (c === 0) c = String(a.name||'').localeCompare(String(b.name||''),'ar');
      return sortDir === 'asc' ? c : -c;
    });
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ٥ · الرسم
     ====================================================================== */
  function renderKPIs(){
    var total = rows.length, active = 0, soon = 0, expired = 0, termsNo = 0;
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      var s = statusOf(r);
      if (s === 'active' || s === 'soon') active++;
      if (s === 'soon') soon++;
      if (s === 'expired') expired++;
      if (!r.terms) termsNo++;
    });
    var set = function(id, v){ var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.textContent = v; };
    set('vehHeroTotal', total); set('vehHeroActive', active); set('vehHeroSoon', soon); set('vehHeroExpired', expired);
    set('vehKpiTotal', total);
    set('vehKpiTotalSub', total ? (total + ' مركبة مسجّلة في النظام') : 'لا توجد عقود بعد');
    set('vehKpiActive', active);
    set('vehKpiActiveSub', total ? (Math.round(active/total*100) + '% من إجمالي العقود') : 'لا توجد عقود بعد');
    set('vehKpiSoon', soon);
    set('vehKpiSoonSub', soon ? 'تحتاج إجراء تجديد أو إنهاء' : 'لا توجد عقود قريبة الانتهاء');
    set('vehKpiExpired', expired);
    set('vehKpiExpiredSub', 'لا تنطبق عليها الشروط: ' + termsNo);
    var bar = document.getElementById('vehKpiActiveBar');
    if (bar) bar.style.width = (total ? Math.round(active/total*100) : 0) + '%';
  }

  function renderDist(){
    function draw(hostId, counts, limit){
      var host = document.getElementById(hostId);
      if (!host) return;
      var keys = Object.keys(counts).sort(function(a,b){ return counts[b]-counts[a]; });
      if (limit) keys = keys.slice(0, limit);
      if (!keys.length){ host.innerHTML = '<div class="veh-empty">لا توجد بيانات</div>'; return; }
      var max = counts[keys[0]] || 1;
      host.innerHTML = keys.map(function(k){
        return '<div class="veh-dist-row">' +
                 '<div class="veh-dist-name" title="' + esc(k) + '">' + esc(k) + '</div>' +
                 '<div class="veh-dist-track"><div class="veh-dist-fill" style="width:' + Math.round(counts[k]/max*100) + '%"></div></div>' +
                 '<div class="veh-dist-val num">' + counts[k] + '</div>' +
               '</div>';
      }).join('');
    }
    var byC = {}, byP = {};
    rows.forEach(function(r){
      var c = r.vclass || 'غير محدد'; byC[c] = (byC[c]||0)+1;
      var p = r.providingDept || 'غير محددة'; byP[p] = (byP[p]||0)+1;
    });
    draw('vehDistClass', byC);
    draw('vehDistDept', byP);
  }

  function renderAlerts(){
    var host = document.getElementById('vehAlertsList');
    if (!host) return;
    var list = rows.filter(function(r){ var s = statusOf(r); return s === 'soon' || s === 'expired'; })
                    .sort(function(a,b){ return (a.end||'').localeCompare(b.end||''); });
    if (!list.length){
      host.innerHTML = '<div class="veh-empty">' +
        '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="m8.5 12.5 2.5 2.5 4.5-5"/></svg>' +
        '<div>لا توجد عقود منتهية أو مقاربة على الانتهاء خلال ٩٠ يومًا.</div></div>';
      return;
    }
    host.innerHTML = list.map(function(r){
      var s = statusOf(r);
      var late = s === 'expired';
      return '<div class="veh-alert">' +
        '<div class="veh-alert-icon' + (late ? ' is-late' : '') + '">' +
          (late ? '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"/><path d="M12 8v4.5M12 16h.01"/></svg>'
                : '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="8.5"/><path d="M12 8v4.5l3 2"/></svg>') +
        '</div>' +
        '<div style="flex:1;">' +
          '<div class="veh-alert-title">' + esc(r.name) + ' — ' + esc(r.contractNo) + '</div>' +
          '<div class="veh-alert-meta">' + esc(r.dept) + ' · مزوّدة من ' + esc(r.providingDept) + ' · ينتهي ' + fmtDate(r.end) + '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="veh-alert-days" style="color:' + (late ? 'var(--rose-text)' : 'var(--amber)') + ';">' + daysLeftLabel(r, s) + '</div>' +
      '</div>';
    }).join('');
  }

  function renderTable(){
    var body = document.getElementById('vehBody');
    if (!body) return;
    var cnt = document.getElementById('vehFilterCount');
    if (cnt) cnt.textContent = 'عرض ' + filtered.length + ' من ' + rows.length + ' مركبة';

    if (!filtered.length){
      body.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="15"><div class="veh-empty">' +
        '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M5 16v2a1 1 0 0 1-1 1H3.5A1.5 1.5 0 0 1 2 17.5V13l2.2-5.2A2 2 0 0 1 6 6.5h12a2 2 0 0 1 1.8 1.3L22 13v4.5a1.5 1.5 0 0 1-1.5 1.5H20a1 1 0 0 1-1-1v-2"/><path d="M2.6 12h18.8"/><circle cx="7" cy="15.5" r="1.4"/><circle cx="17" cy="15.5" r="1.4"/></svg>' +
        '<div>' + (rows.length ? 'لا توجد نتائج مطابقة للتصفية الحالية.' : 'لا توجد مركبات مسجّلة بعد — اضغط «إضافة مركبة» للبدء.') + '</div>' +
        '</div></td></tr>';
      return;
    }

    body.innerHTML = filtered.map(function(r){
      var s = statusOf(r);
      var editable = canEdit(r);
      return '<tr>' +
        '<td style="font-weight:600;">' + esc(r.name) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + esc(r.empNo || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.dept || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.providingDept || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="task-cell">' + esc(r.project || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + esc(r.contractNo || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.make || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + esc(r.model || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td>' + esc(r.vclass || '—') + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + fmtDate(r.start) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num">' + fmtDate(r.end) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:center;">' + statusBadge(s) + '</td>' +
        '<td class="num" style="text-align:center;">' + daysLeftLabel(r, s) + '</td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:center;"><span class="veh-flag ' + (r.terms ? 'veh-yes' : 'veh-no') + '">' + (r.terms ? 'تنطبق' : 'لا تنطبق') + '</span></td>' +
        '<td style="text-align:center;"><div class="veh-row-actions">' +
          '<button type="button" class="veh-icon-btn" data-edit="' + esc(r._id) + '" title="' + (editable ? 'تعديل' : 'تعديل — يتطلب صلاحية') + '"' + (editable ? '' : ' style="opacity:.5"') + '>' +
            '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4Z"/></svg>' +
          '</button>' +
          '<button type="button" class="veh-icon-btn danger" data-del="' + esc(r._id) + '" title="' + (editable ? 'حذف' : 'حذف — يتطلب صلاحية') + '"' + (editable ? '' : ' style="opacity:.5"') + '>' +
            '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 7h16M9 7V5a1 1 0 0 1 1-1h4a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v2M6 7l1 13a1 1 0 0 0 1 1h8a1 1 0 0 0 1-1l1-13"/></svg>' +
          '</button>' +
        '</div></td>' +
      '</tr>';
    }).join('');
  }

  function renderFilters(){
    function fill(id, values, keep){
      var sel = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!sel) return;
      var cur = sel.value;
      var first = sel.options[0] ? sel.options[0].outerHTML : '';
      sel.innerHTML = first + values.map(function(v){ return '<option value="' + esc(v) + '">' + esc(v) + '</option>'; }).join('');
      if (keep && values.indexOf(cur) !== -1) sel.value = cur;
    }
    fill('vehFDept', uniq(rows.map(function(r){ return r.dept; })), true);
    fill('vehFProv', uniq(rows.map(function(r){ return r.providingDept; })), true);
    fill('vehFClass', VEH_CLASSES, true);
  }

  function alertRows(){
    return rows.filter(function(r){ var s = statusOf(r); return s === 'soon' || s === 'expired'; });
  }

  function renderBell(){
    var bell = document.getElementById('vehBell');
    var cnt  = document.getElementById('vehBellCount');
    var n = alertRows().length;
    if (cnt) cnt.textContent = n;
    if (bell){
      if (n) bell.classList.add('has-new');
      else bell.classList.remove('has-new');
    }
  }

  function renderAll(){
    renderFilters();
    applyFilters();
    renderKPIs();
    renderDist();
    renderAlerts();
    renderBell();
    renderTable();
    refreshSessionUI();
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ٦ · نموذج الإضافة والتعديل
     ====================================================================== */
  function fillSelect(id, values, selected){
    var sel = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!sel) return;
    sel.innerHTML = values.map(function(v){
      return '<option value="' + esc(v) + '"' + (v === selected ? ' selected' : '') + '>' + esc(v) + '</option>';
    }).join('');
  }
  function fillDatalist(id, values){
    var dl = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!dl) return;
    dl.innerHTML = values.map(function(v){ return '<option value="' + esc(v) + '">'; }).join('');
  }
  function openModal(row){
    editingId = row ? row._id : null;
    var t = document.getElementById('vehModalTitle');
    if (t) t.textContent = row ? 'تعديل بيانات المركبة' : 'إضافة مركبة';

    var mine = me();
    var depts = uniq(rows.map(function(r){ return r.dept; }).concat((typeof AUTHORIZED_USERS !== 'undefined') ? AUTHORIZED_USERS.map(function(u){ return u.id; }) : []));
    fillSelect('vehInDept', depts, row ? row.dept : (mine || depts[0]));
    fillSelect('vehInProv', uniq(VEH_PROVIDERS.concat(rows.map(function(r){ return r.providingDept; }))), row ? row.providingDept : VEH_PROVIDERS[0]);
    fillSelect('vehInClass', VEH_CLASSES, row ? row.vclass : VEH_CLASSES[0]);
    fillDatalist('vehProjectList', uniq(rows.map(function(r){ return r.project; })));

    var set = function(id, v){ var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.value = v || ''; };
    set('vehInName', row && row.name);
    set('vehInEmpNo', row && row.empNo);
    set('vehInProject', row && row.project);
    set('vehInContract', row && row.contractNo);
    set('vehInMake', row && row.make);
    set('vehInModel', row && row.model);
    set('vehInStart', row && row.start);
    set('vehInEnd', row && row.end);
    var termsSel = document.getElementById('vehInTerms');
    if (termsSel) termsSel.value = (row && !row.terms) ? '0' : '1';

    var ov = document.getElementById('vehModalOverlay');
    if (ov) ov.classList.add('open');
    var f = document.getElementById('vehInName');
    if (f) setTimeout(function(){ f.focus(); }, 60);
  }
  function closeModal(){
    var ov = document.getElementById('vehModalOverlay');
    if (ov) ov.classList.remove('open');
    editingId = null;
  }
  function submitForm(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!authed()){ guard(function(){}); return; }
    var rec = {
      name: val('vehInName'), empNo: val('vehInEmpNo'), dept: val('vehInDept'),
      providingDept: val('vehInProv'), project: val('vehInProject'), contractNo: val('vehInContract'),
      vclass: val('vehInClass'), make: val('vehInMake'), model: val('vehInModel'),
      start: val('vehInStart'), end: val('vehInEnd'), terms: val('vehInTerms') === '1'
    };
    if (editingId){
      var idx = -1;
      for (var i=0;i<rows.length;i++){ if (rows[i]._id === editingId){ idx = i; break; } }
      if (idx === -1){ closeModal(); return; }
      if (!canEdit(rows[idx])){ toast('غير مصرح لك بتعديل هذا السجل'); return; }
      rec._id = editingId;
      rows[idx] = rec;
      toast('تم تحديث بيانات المركبة ✓');
    } else {
      if (!admin() && me() && rec.dept !== me()){ toast('غير مصرح لك بإضافة سجل يخص إدارة أخرى'); return; }
      rec._id = uid();
      rows.push(rec);
      toast('تمت إضافة المركبة ✓');
    }
    saveRows();
    closeModal();
    renderAll();
  }
  function removeRow(id){
    var r = rows.filter(function(x){ return x._id === id; })[0];
    if (!r) return;
    if (!canEdit(r)){ toast('غير مصرح لك بحذف هذا السجل'); return; }
    if (!confirm('حذف مركبة «' + (r.name||'') + '» — ' + (r.contractNo||'') + '؟')) return;
    rows = rows.filter(function(x){ return x._id !== id; });
    saveRows();
    renderAll();
    toast('تم حذف السجل');
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ٧ · التصدير والطباعة
     ====================================================================== */
  function q_(v){ return '"' + String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/"/g,'""') + '"'; }
  function csvBlob(lines, fname){
    var blob = new Blob(['\uFEFF' + lines.join('\r\n')], {type:'text/csv;charset=utf-8;'});
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    a.download = fname;
    document.body.appendChild(a); a.click();
    setTimeout(function(){ URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); a.remove(); }, 400);
  }
  function exportCSV(){
    var head = ['اسم المستخدم','الرقم الوظيفي','إدارة الموظف','الإدارة المزودة','اسم المشروع','رقم العقد','نوع السيارة','الموديل','فئة المركبة','بداية العقد','نهاية العقد','حالة العقد','الشروط'];
    var lines = [head.map(q_).join(',')];
    filtered.forEach(function(r){
      lines.push([r.name,r.empNo,r.dept,r.providingDept,r.project,r.contractNo,r.make,r.model,r.vclass,r.start,r.end,statusLabel(statusOf(r)),(r.terms?'تنطبق':'لا تنطبق')].map(q_).join(','));
    });
    csvBlob(lines, 'بيانات-المركبات-' + todayStr() + '.csv');
    toast('تم تحميل ' + filtered.length + ' سجلًا ✓');
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     ٨ · الربط
     ====================================================================== */
  function bind(){
    var logo = document.getElementById('vehLogo');
    var src  = document.querySelector('#heroBanner .brand-mark img');
    if (logo && src && src.getAttribute('src')) logo.src = src.getAttribute('src');

    var back = document.getElementById('vehBackHome');
    if (back) back.addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (typeof window.SE_GO_HOME === 'function') window.SE_GO_HOME();
      else { location.hash = '#home'; location.reload(); }
    });

    var bell = document.getElementById('vehBell');
    if (bell) bell.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var sec = document.getElementById('vehSecAlerts');
      if (sec) sec.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth', block:'start'});
    });

    var themeBtn = document.getElementById('vehTheme');
    function syncThemeIcons(){
      var dark = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark';
      var sun  = document.querySelector('#vehTheme .theme-icon-sun');
      var moon = document.querySelector('#vehTheme .theme-icon-moon');
      if (sun)  sun.style.display  = dark ? 'none' : '';
      if (moon) moon.style.display = dark ? '' : 'none';
    }
    if (themeBtn) themeBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var cur = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark';
      document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-theme', cur);
      try{ localStorage.setItem('fk_sec_dashboard_theme_v1', cur); }catch(e){}
      syncThemeIcons();
    });
    syncThemeIcons();

    var pill = document.getElementById('vehSessionPill');
    if (pill) pill.addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (authed()){
        if (!confirm('هل تريد تسجيل الخروج؟')) return;
        try{ if (typeof setCurrentUser === 'function') setCurrentUser(null); }catch(e){}
        try{ if (typeof setAuthToken === 'function') setAuthToken(null); }catch(e){}
        renderAll();
        toast('تم تسجيل الخروج');
      } else if (typeof openLoginModal === 'function'){
        openLoginModal();
      }
    });

    var addBtn = document.getElementById('vehBtnAdd');
    if (addBtn) addBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){ guard(function(){ openModal(null); }); });

    var cancel = document.getElementById('vehBtnCancel');
    if (cancel) cancel.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    var close = document.getElementById('vehModalClose');
    if (close) close.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    var ov = document.getElementById('vehModalOverlay');
    if (ov) ov.addEventListener('click', function(e){ if (e.target === ov) closeModal(); });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if (e.key === 'Escape' && ov && ov.classList.contains('open')) closeModal(); });

    var form = document.getElementById('vehForm');
    if (form) form.addEventListener('submit', submitForm);

    var body = document.getElementById('vehBody');
    if (body) body.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var ed = e.target.closest('[data-edit]');
      if (ed){
        var id = ed.getAttribute('data-edit');
        guard(function(){
          var r = rows.filter(function(x){ return x._id === id; })[0];
          if (!r) return;
          if (!canEdit(r)){ toast('غير مصرح لك بتعديل سجل إدارة أخرى'); return; }
          openModal(r);
        });
        return;
      }
      var dl = e.target.closest('[data-del]');
      if (dl){ var did = dl.getAttribute('data-del'); guard(function(){ removeRow(did); }); }
    });

    var FILTERS = ['vehFSearch','vehFDept','vehFProv','vehFClass','vehFStatus','vehFTerms'];
    FILTERS.forEach(function(id){
      var el = document.getElementById(id);
      if (!el) return;
      el.addEventListener(el.tagName === 'INPUT' ? 'input' : 'change', function(){ applyFilters(); renderTable(); });
    });
    var reset = document.getElementById('vehFReset');
    if (reset) reset.addEventListener('click', function(){
      FILTERS.forEach(function(id){ var el = document.getElementById(id); if (el) el.value = ''; });
      applyFilters(); renderTable();
    });

    var ths = document.querySelectorAll('#vehTable th.sortable');
    [].forEach.call(ths, function(th){
      th.addEventListener('click', function(){
        var k = th.getAttribute('data-sort');
        if (sortKey === k) sortDir = (sortDir === 'asc' ? 'desc' : 'asc');
        else { sortKey = k; sortDir = 'asc'; }
        [].forEach.call(ths, function(x){ x.classList.remove('active','dir-asc','dir-desc'); });
        th.classList.add('active', sortDir === 'asc' ? 'dir-asc' : 'dir-desc');
        applyFilters(); renderTable();
      });
    });

    var dl2 = document.getElementById('vehBtnDownload');
    if (dl2) dl2.addEventListener('click', exportCSV);
    var pr = document.getElementById('vehBtnPrint');
    if (pr) pr.addEventListener('click', function(){ window.print(); });

    var nav = document.getElementById('vehNav');
    if (nav){
      var items = [].slice.call(nav.querySelectorAll('.section-nav-item'));
      var spy = function(){
        nav.classList.toggle('scrolled', window.scrollY > 40);
        var best = null, bestD = 1e9;
        items.forEach(function(a){
          var sec = document.getElementById(a.getAttribute('data-target'));
          if (!sec) return;
          var d = Math.abs(sec.getBoundingClientRect().top - 120);
          if (d < bestD){ bestD = d; best = a; }
        });
        items.forEach(function(a){ a.classList.toggle('active', a === best); });
      };
      window.addEventListener('scroll', spy, {passive:true});
      spy();
    }

    var lastAuth = authed() + '|' + (me() || '') + '|' + admin();
    setInterval(function(){
      var now = authed() + '|' + (me() || '') + '|' + admin();
      if (now !== lastAuth){ lastAuth = now; renderAll(); }
    }, 800);
  }

  rows = loadRows();
  bind();
  renderAll();
})();
</script>

<script id="se-veh-hero-3d">
(function(){
  function boot(){
    if (typeof window.seBuildGrid === 'function'){
      window.seBuildGrid('vehHeroGrid','vehHeroBand',{notHome:true});
    }
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
